companies.name: Simantic
companies.originalOneLiner: Firmware simulation for AI agents
companies.originalDescription: Simantic is modernizing the embedded firmware industry with hardware simulation developed for the adoption of AI in hardware engineering. Simantic gives both humans and AI the visibility into hardware previously limited by the physical world.
companies.story: 这是做嵌入式固件仿真工具的公司，服务对象是硬件工程团队。想象你是一家电子设备厂商的固件工程负责人，今天要验证一段新写的驱动代码，可手边的电路板只有两块，排队等实机测试要等好几天，改一行代码就得重新烧录一次。Simantic 把硬件放进仿真环境里跑，让人和智能体都能看清原本被物理世界挡住的硬件内部状态，工程师可以先在虚拟板子上反复试，再上真机。这家公司来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，方向落在开发工具、半导体和电子这几块，说明它想解决的是硬件研发里最耗时间的那一段，而不是再做一个通用软件工具。

companies.name: Multiplier
companies.originalOneLiner: Agent harnesses for asset managers
companies.originalDescription: Multiplier helps institutional investors research stocks and manage their portfolios. We're live with six hedge funds, and our users spend 4+ hours a day in the platform. Investors who try "nearly every tool on the market," to quote a client of ours, "wind up with an unwieldy collection of fragmented point solutions." Those who focus on building a great setup with general agents are instead "signing up for a full-time job." So we deploy a platform called Multiplier that unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI work, human work, and tacit firm knowledge in one secure, governed, customized application. Our first vertical: independent equity funds with $250M-$5B of assets. They know AI is essential for staying relevant, but they don't have the time or talent to figure out what to do about it. But once we deploy Multiplier––"We used to spend 80% of our time gathering information and 20% of our time acting on it," said one customer. "Multiplier has flipped those percentages."
companies.story: 这家公司切的是资产管理机构的研究与投资工作流。假如你是一位管理着几十亿美元资产的股票基金经理，每天早上要在十几个数据终端、表格和聊天记录之间来回翻，找一份财报里的关键数字可能要花半小时，一天下来八成时间都在收集信息。Multiplier 把结构化数据、非结构化资料、人工智能的工作和人的判断收进一个受治理的定制平台，让研究员和基金经理在同一个地方完成调研和组合管理。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在招聘，目前已有六家对冲基金在用，用户每天在平台上待四小时以上，这个使用深度本身就是值得关注的信号。

companies.name: Replicas
companies.originalOneLiner: Run any coding agent harness in the cloud
companies.originalDescription: Replicas is a cloud coding agent that allows you to delegate tasks to Claude Code or Codex from the app, Slack, Linear, and more. Each task works inside of a sandboxed virtual machine, allowing teams to heavily parallelize work and burn through tickets. Replicas agents output higher quality PRs via feedback loops - each task automatically is notified and fixes CI failures and reads all code reviews. With Environments, engineering teams can configure agents to run their entire codebase locally, verify its work, and provide preview URLs.
companies.story: 这是给工程团队用的云端编程智能体平台。如果你是一位工程负责人，手上积压了几十张工单，团队里每个人都在等代码评审，而 Claude Code 或 Codex 只能开在某个人的笔记本上，任务一多就排不过来。Replicas 让每个任务跑在独立的沙箱虚拟机里，可以从应用、Slack 或 Linear 直接派活，团队因此能大规模并行处理工单，智能体还会自己收到构建失败的通知并修复，也会读代码评审意见再改。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，卖点是把并行和反馈闭环做进开发流程，而不是单纯多开几个窗口。

companies.name: Voltair
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous Drones for Earth Observation
companies.originalDescription: Voltair is building the world's first globally distributed network of autonomous drones for Earth observation. Power utilities are the perfect first customer. Aging infrastructure and extreme weather drive the need for millimeter-scale inspection data on the power grid. Utilities spend tens of billions of dollars every year just looking at their own equipment. Autonomous drone fleets will enable utilities to inspect 7 million miles of infrastructure more frequently, quickly, and accurately. Our long-range, weatherized flying robots work with charging pads installed directly on utility poles. Each new pad unlocks 1000 square miles of coverage. With a charging network deployed on the power grid, we can serve existing multi-billion dollar data markets in road, rail and telecom inspection at 10x lower prices while enabling entirely new applications in hyperlocal weather monitoring, forestry, construction, search & rescue, and insurance. We envision a future in which drone "instances" are requested on-demand through our platform, enabling any application builder to serve these critical markets without ever operating their own hardware.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是用于地球观测的自主无人机网络。设想你是一家电力公司的巡检主管，辖区里有成千上万座电塔和线路穿过山区，暴风雪过后要派人爬塔检查，既慢又危险，而公司每年花在“看自己设备”上的钱是数十亿美元级别。Voltair 让长航程、耐候的飞行机器人从装在电线杆上的充电垫起飞，每新增一个充电点就能覆盖上千平方英里，把巡检做得更频繁也更细。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，正在招聘，先切电力行业再向公路、铁路和通信巡检延伸，这个从充电网络长出来的覆盖逻辑是它值得看的地方。

companies.name: Floracene
companies.originalOneLiner: Vibecode + deploy HIPAA-compliant internal tools, no eng team needed
companies.originalDescription: Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team. The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. The tool then dies locally on the builder’s computer, because IT (correctly) won't let anyone deploy a tool touching PHI without first-class authentication and permissioning. Our first customer had multiple employees who had each built useful tools and dashboards locally, but couldn’t actually share these with coworkers or connect to their core practice data. Within weeks of implementing Floracene, they were able to consolidate their BI tooling into Floracene and shipped 4 net-new to production. A staggering ~$200B is spent on administrative software in healthcare every year in the US. Tens of thousands of those companies still run core operations on spreadsheets, and we're at the top of the first inning of AI adoption. Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.
companies.story: 这是帮医疗机构搭建合规内部工具的公司。想象你是一家诊所的运营负责人，前台同事用一下午拼出一个排班小工具，很好用，却只能留在她自己的电脑上，因为信息技术部门不敢让任何碰病人数据的程序上线。Floracene 让人用自然语言描述需要的工具，一键部署，接上生产数据，并按用户划分读写权限，等于把搭建工具和合规上线这两步接了起来。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，目前不招聘，第一个客户有多个员工各自做过本地工具却无法共享，这类场景说明医疗后台的瓶颈已经从“会不会做”变成了“能不能安全地用”。

companies.name: Taiga
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous medical billing
companies.originalDescription: Taiga automates medical billing for doctor's offices. A doctor uploads their visit data, our AI figures out the right billing codes, checks the claim for errors, and submits it to insurance, dealing with any denials. Faster billing, fewer rejected claims, less busywork. We're Nanda and Adam, friends since 3rd grade. Both of our parents are doctors with their own practices, and billing was always a source of stress and lost revenue for them. We want providers to treat patients while we handle the rest.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向诊所的自动医疗账务。假如你是一位独立执业医生的前台主管，每天诊疗结束后要对着记录逐条判断该用哪个计费代码，填错就被保险公司退回，拒付和拖欠让收入一点点漏掉。Taiga 让医生上传就诊数据，由人工智能判断代码、检查理赔单有没有错误、提交给保险公司，并跟进被拒的理赔。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，两位创始人的父母都经营自己的诊所，账务一直是压力和收入损失的来源，这个从家庭诊所长出来的切入点让它的场景显得具体。

companies.name: Illume Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: 24/7 Personal Health & Longevity Companion
companies.originalDescription: Illume is a 24/7 AI personal health & longevity companion that connects your wearables, blood panels, and genomic data to text you personalized and actionable insights. We pull in your health data and fuse it into one secure model. You get daily text updates on what changed, what it means, and what to do next; conversational health Q&A like "What should I do to improve my bloodwork?"; cross-data trend detection that catches patterns individual platforms miss; and a full platform to dig deeper, explore your health data, and text your Illume agent anytime. We're 3 MIT grads & friends, with experience at Windsurf, MIT CSAIL, Eli Lilly, & the Broad Institute.
companies.story: 这是做个人健康与长寿陪伴服务的公司，能力放在可穿戴设备和随身场景里，不只是手机上的一个应用。如果你是一个每天戴着手环、刚做完血液检查的运动用户，报告出来一堆指标，你不知道哪项变化值得在意，也不知道下一步该调整什么。Illume 把可穿戴数据、血液面板和基因数据汇进一个安全模型，每天用短信告诉你什么变了、意味着什么、接下来做什么，也能回答“我该怎么改善血检结果”这类问题，还会跨数据找单个平台看不到的趋势。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人，都是麻省理工学院的毕业生，曾在 Windsurf、麻省理工学院计算机科学与人工智能实验室、礼来和布罗德研究所工作。

companies.name: Perseus Defense
companies.originalOneLiner: America's Golden Dome for Drones
companies.originalDescription: Perseus Defense is building a mass-manufactured Counter UAS solution for the Department of Defense and Department of Homeland Security. Current solutions are one-to-one, too dangerous for use on U.S. soil, and orders of magntiude more expensive than the threats they defeat. Our self-guided missile platform is man-portable and multi-domain capable. It senses, engages, and eliminates threats with drastically reduced cost per engagement over existing kinetic solutions. Solving this critical national security problem requires understanding complex DoD needs along with actual rocket science including aerodynamics, guidance, navigation, control, and much more. Jason and Steve met at Penn State while they pursued their PhD and MS in aerospace engineering, respectively. Their past experiences designing space helicopters for NASA, making Boeing airliners land autonomously, controlling swarms of unmanned autonomous systems, teaching aerospace engineering at Stanford, winning multiple ONR and DOE engineering competitions, and founding an international drone competition makes them the perfect team to create transformative solutions protecting our service members. "If you build this, it will be mandatory equipment for every truck, boat, and convoy in the U.S. Military. We're talking thousands of units." - Former DoD Procurement Officer The White House just released Executive Order, "Unleashing American Drone Dominance" which adds billions of dollars, government support, and streamlined regulations to enable the development of our product. Traction: Jason and Steve used more than 100 end-user interviews across the DoD and DHS to shape the product to something of critical need to both boots on the ground and DoD purchasers. In 8 short weeks following a strict 2-week design-build-test cycle, the team has gone through 4 major guided missile iterations with over 30 live-fire flight tests. They were invited to Ft. Hood to present their platform to the 1st Cavalry Division, and also briefed the Pentagon and U.S. congressmen on current U.S. vulnerabilities to advanced drone technology. Perseus Defense is actively standing up cooperative research agreements with U.S. Army DEVCOM's Applied Research Laboratory, Aviation and Missile Center, Armaments Center, and High Performance Computing Modernization Program.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是反无人机防御系统，客户是美国国防部和国土安全部。设想你是一个负责基地低空安全的防御项目官员，现有拦截手段基本是一对一，价格比要防的无人机贵出几个数量级，而且很多方案在美国本土使用风险太大。Perseus Defense 做的是可单兵携带、多域适用的自导导弹平台，能感知、交战并消除威胁，单次交战的成本比现有动能方案低得多。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队三人，正在招聘，两位创始人在宾夕法尼亚州立大学分别攻读航空航天工程博士和硕士，做过为美国航空航天局设计太空直升机、让波音客机自主降落和控制无人机集群等工作。

companies.name: Intelligence Factory
companies.originalOneLiner: Human Intelligence for Robots
companies.originalDescription: Robotics is the new paradigm. With hardware converging, Intelligence is the biggest bottleneck. Our world was built for humans and we're giving robots the ability to reason and act like us. The way we learn any task - by seeing, doing, and feeling - is how we train robots. We're building general intelligence that works on any robot and fits seamlessly within our world.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是给机器人提供通用智能的训练与部署。想象你是一家工厂的自动化负责人，新买来的机械臂换个工位就不会干活，重新编程要请集成商来现场待上几周，产线一改就得重来。Intelligence Factory 的思路是让机器人像人一样通过看、做和感受来学习任务，把训练出的通用能力装到不同机器人身上，让它们适应为人类建造的世界。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队十人，正在招聘，在硬件逐渐趋同的判断下，它押注智能是当前最大的瓶颈，这个十人规模也说明它已经在做工程化而不是只停留在演示。

companies.name: Alter
companies.originalOneLiner: YC S25) – Access control for multi-user agents
companies.originalDescription: YC S25) – Access control for multi-user agents
companies.story: 这家公司做的是多用户智能体的访问控制。假如你是一个团队里负责智能体落地的工程负责人，同事们共用一个智能体账号，谁都能让它读文件、调接口、改数据，出了问题却查不清是谁授权的哪一步。Alter 想解决的正是这个麻烦，把权限边界加到多人共用的智能体上，让不同的人在同一套智能体里只做被允许的事。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，在 Launch HN 上发布，输入里没有团队人数、客户或收入信息，所以值得看的地方在于场景本身：智能体从个人玩具走向团队协作时，权限和审计会先变成绕不过去的一关。

readings.title: NVIDIA Kumo Forecast Combines Pretrained Time-Series Representations with Historical Pattern Retrieval and Interpretability
readings.story: 做预测的人常会碰到一种尴尬：模型在训练集上表现不错，一到真实业务里就失灵，因为历史数据里的模式没那么干净。这篇来自 Hugging Face 的文章介绍 NVIDIA 的 Kumo Forecast，把预训练的时间序列表示和历史模式检索放在一起，还强调可解释性。值得读的地方在于，它没有只讲模型多强，而是把“怎么让预测结果能被人理解和信任”当成问题的一部分。读的时候可以留意作者如何拆解预测任务：哪些部分交给预训练表示，哪些部分靠检索历史相似模式，以及可解释性是在哪个环节被加进去的。

readings.title: Numbering Should Start at Zero (1982) [pdf]
readings.story: 程序员大概都遇到过从 0 还是从 1 开始编号的争论，有时候是在写循环，有时候是在讨论数组下标，有时候只是同事之间一句玩笑。这篇 1982 年的短文最近又出现在 Hacker News 上，说明这个老问题还在被反复提起。它值得读，不是因为给出了标准答案，而是因为它展示了一种把日常习惯上升为设计原则的思考方式。读的时候可以看作者怎么界定问题、怎么用例子推进论证，以及他如何判断哪种编号方式更不容易让人出错。

readings.title: The Download: introducing the Impossible issue
readings.story: 翻开一本技术杂志的专题，读者往往先想知道：这期为什么选这个主题，它和当下有什么关系。MIT Technology Review 的 The Download 推出“Impossible issue”，从标题看是在围绕那些看似不可能的目标组织内容。这类导览值得读，是因为它像一张地图，帮人快速判断哪些方向正在被认真对待。读的时候可以留意编辑如何挑选和排列话题：哪些“不可能”被放在前面，它们之间有没有共同的线索，以及这种编排本身透露了怎样的判断。

companies.name: Mount
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI Agent Insurance Carrier
companies.originalDescription: TLDR: Mount is building the AI insurance carrier, starting with liability coverage for deployed AI agents. As everyone moves AI Agents into production and gives them more responsibility, we help businesses insure and secure them. Whenever responsibility shifts from human operators to autonomous systems, so too does the liability that accompanies it. The systems also introduce new risks: agentic software failures, prompt injection attacks, autonomous workflow errors, data leaks, and more. Legacy insurance was not built for this. Existing policies are often silent, ambiguous, or exclude autonomous software, and traditional insurers lack the data and technical capability to assess deployed AI Systems. Our first product, the Mount AI Liability Policy, is built for mid-market and enterprise companies deploying autonomous AI agents in real business processes. We scan and red-team AI deployments, quantify operational risk, help fix vulnerabilities, and insure the residual risk with purpose-built AI liability coverage. Mount is best thought of as a highly automated version of today's commercial insurance carriers, which run on manual workflows, layers of intermediaries, and tens of thousands of employees. AI enables automation of underwriting, pricing, policy issuance, claims, fraud detection, customer support, and distribution. We believe that the best way to use this opportunity is to rebuild those processes from the ground up.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是人工智能保险方向，正在搭建面向智能体的保险承保方。假如你是一家企业的法务或运营负责人，刚把几个自主运行的智能体放进真实的业务流程里，董事会忽然问起：如果智能体自己下错单、发错邮件、泄露了数据，责任算谁的？传统保单对自主软件往往沉默、含糊，甚至直接排除，而老牌保险公司也缺少评估已部署人工智能系统的数据和技术能力。Mount 的第一款产品是面向部署自主智能体企业的责任险，会扫描并红队测试部署环境，再据此定价承保。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队只有两人，场景本身说明这个空白正在被真实需求推着走。

companies.name: Cyberdesk
companies.originalOneLiner: Self learning computer use agent for developers
companies.originalDescription: Cyberdesk is the first self learning computer use agent for developers to automate desktop workflows. For example, one of our customers is building an AI agent for hospital patient intake, and they’re using us to automate an entire team of people manually clicking and typing into a desktop app to book appointments. We launched mid July, and our agent is already operating in production environments, creating appointments in electronic health record apps and processing files in legacy ERPs. We’ve built the first computer use agent that memorizes tasks and repeats them quickly while still adapting to unexpected changes on the screen. A good analogy is to how humans use computers: once we get used to an app, we use it much faster, while still adapting to random popups and crashes. This new paradigm for computer use will be needed by every company automating human workflows on computers. Mahmoud previously built robotic process automation solutions impacting 20K+ employees at a Fortune 100 company. He also built AI & ML solutions at Baylor College of Medicine Neuroscience & Texas Children's Hospital + co-published a paper at the Rice Networks Group. Alan is ex-NASA and previously dropped out to be the first founding engineer at a PearX startup. He is a second time founder, having previously built and scaled a consumer AI app to thousands of paying users. Computer-use agents will automate the $6T dollars spent on enterprise knowledge work and Cyberdesk will be the platform to power this. We’d love to talk with you! https://cal.com/mahmoud-al-madi-klrs5s/30min
companies.story: 这是给开发者用的电脑操作智能体，走的是桌面工作流自动化方向。想象你在一家医院的信息部门，每天有一整组人对着同一个电子病历桌面软件反复点击、录入、预约，系统老旧又没有接口，招人培训都跟不上。Cyberdesk 的智能体能记住这些操作并快速重复，同时还能应对屏幕上突然弹出的窗口或崩溃，而不是死板回放脚本。它七月中旬发布，已经在生产环境里创建预约、处理老式企业管理系统里的文件，有客户正拿它做病人接诊流程。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队两人，值得看的是这类桌面自动化几乎是每家公司都会碰到的硬骨头。

companies.name: Caution
companies.location: George Town, George Town, Cayman Islands
companies.originalOneLiner: Hosting platform for software you can't afford to have hacked
companies.originalDescription: Caution is a hosting platform for software you can't afford to get hacked. It simplifies and extends confidential compute, and lets developers deploy workloads to secure enclaves in minutes and give customers, auditors, and counterparties cryptographic proof that production is running the exact reviewed source code, build, configuration, and runtime - not an opaque binary controlled by a cloud operator or internal admin. Confidential computing hardware exists, but the tooling is too fragmented and incomplete for most teams to use well. Today, attestation often proves only that a binary has a certain hash; it does not prove what source code produced that binary. Building the missing deployment, reproducibility, and verification layer requires specialized security engineering and often locks teams into one cloud or hardware stack. Caution turns that into a simple git-based workflow that builds reproducible enclave images, provisions infrastructure, and lets anyone independently verify what is running. We built Caution after years securing high-risk systems through Distrust, where we worked with hedge funds, custodians, blockchain teams, cloud platforms, and critical grid operators on systems responsible for more than $600B in assets. Again and again, the same problem showed up: teams running mission-critical infrastructure could not reliably prove what was executing in production. As AI, fintech, healthcare, and regulated data collaboration move into the cloud, "trust us" is no longer enough. Caution is a general-purpose platform: if it runs on a server, it can run verifiably on Caution. We're starting where trust failures cost the most, but we believe verifiable compute will become the default way software runs, the same way HTTPS became the default way it's served. Infrastructure you can verify, not trust.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是机密计算托管平台，服务那些一旦被攻破就后果严重的软件。如果你是一位工程负责人，客户或审计方要求你证明生产环境跑的正是经过审查的那份源码，而不是云厂商或内部管理员手里的某个不透明二进制文件，你会发现现有工具碎片化得几乎没法用。Caution 把机密计算封装成基于代码仓库的简单工作流，让团队几分钟内把负载部署进安全飞地，并向客户、审计方和交易对手提供密码学证明，覆盖源码、构建、配置和运行时。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队五人，说明这个缺口正卡住不少需要强信任的团队。

companies.name: Klaimee
companies.originalOneLiner: Liability insurance for AI Agents. You deploy agents, we cover you.
companies.originalDescription: Klaimee is the first insurance for your AI agents. It covers what traditional E&O and cyber explicitly carve out, so you can deploy agentic AI at scale with real peace of mind. Built for companies deploying agentic AI, self-serve from day one. The problem: AI agents are taking actions autonomously buying, emailing, modifying sensitive data. AB 316 already holds deployers liable. EU AI Act enforces in August. Cyber and E&O insurance are excluding AI claims. Companies shipping agents have zero coverage and no third-party proof their agent is safe. Enterprise legal asks "who pays if your agent breaks something?" and there's no good answer. We built the answer. Critical-category risk evaluation, certification, financial guarantee, liability insurance and the documentation enterprise procurement needs to sign off. Team: Ines (ex-General Manager at SafetyWing, grew insurance product from $5M to $60M revenue, 5 years launching insurance products from scratch and structuring a TokioMarine MGA into its own carrier) + Julien (AI software engineer + corporate strategy, enterprise compliance). We understand how insurance works, what enterprises require, and why startups can't wait 6 months for either.
companies.story: 这是给人工智能智能体做责任保险的公司，方向是把传统保单明确排除的风险接过来。假如你负责一家正在大规模部署智能体的公司，企业采购和法务会追着问：如果你的智能体自己买东西、发邮件、改动敏感数据，出了事谁赔？现行网络安全险和职业责任险正在把人工智能相关索赔排除在外，而监管也在收紧。Klaimee 提供关键类别的风险评估、认证、财务担保和责任险，以及企业采购签字所需的文档，从第一天起就支持自助购买。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人且正在招聘，值得关注的是它把承保和合规证明放在同一个产品里。

companies.name: Hue
companies.originalOneLiner: Test agents in realistic worlds built from production usage
companies.originalDescription: Hue turns production usage of agents into repeatable tests that preserve the tools, data, and state behind the real run. As AI agents take on real work, their behavior depends increasingly on the nuances of the world around them. With Hue, teams can test and improve their agents under conditions that mimic real usage.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是智能体测试工具，让团队用真实使用记录来检验智能体。如果你是一位负责智能体上线的工程负责人，线上偶尔出现的怪异行为总在测试环境里复现不了，因为真实运行依赖的工具、数据和状态在测试里根本不存在。Hue 把生产环境中的使用过程转成可重复的测试，保留那次真实运行背后的工具、数据和状态，让团队在接近真实的条件下测试和改进智能体。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人。随着智能体接手越来越多实际工作，它的行为越来越取决于周围世界的细节，这正是这类测试值得看的原因。

companies.name: Sutrix
companies.originalOneLiner: Deployed AI to turn EHR data into study-ready datasets
companies.originalDescription: Sutrix turns messy data from EHRs, clinical notes, wearables, and surveys into clean, study-ready datasets allowing hospital research teams' to deliver tailored patient care faster. Before a clinical study can start, research staff spend weeks pulling patient data from disconnected systems like the EHR, REDCap, and wearable platforms, reading notes chart by chart, and reconciling conflicting entries in spreadsheets. Sutrix automates that work by deploying AI systems within each team’s own environment, linking patient records across sources, applying the study's rules, and flagging unclear cases for staff to review. Paying research teams at 10+ institutions cut data prep by 80% going from weeks per study to days. We're brothers who've built together for 4 years. We first solved this problem doing forward-deployed work at HSS, where we built an injury surveillance system now used by 700+ teams. Ritvik's clinical research at HSS and Emory showed us every research team has the same bottleneck. Supratik previously founded Kairo (a16z Speedrun, exited) and built production AI agents at Amazon.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是医疗研究数据整理，把电子病历等杂乱信息变成可直接用于研究的数据集。想象你在一家医院的研究团队，一项临床研究还没开始， staff 就要花几周从电子病历、REDCap 和可穿戴设备平台里捞病人数据，逐份读病历，再在表格里核对互相矛盾的记录。Sutrix 把人工智能系统部署在团队自己的环境里，跨来源关联病人记录，套用研究规则，并把不清楚的病例标出来交给人工复核。它称已有十多家机构的研究团队付费使用，数据准备时间从每项研究数周缩短到几天。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，场景本身就说明了痛点有多具体。

companies.name: Origami Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Manipulate Anything Robot
companies.originalDescription: We are building a "manipulate anything" model with the robot hardware that embodies it. We designed a hand-based data-collection device and a high DOF, direct drive robotic hand that match each other exactly, enabling us to eliminate embodiment gap and collect real-world data and deploy it directly. We want to scale real world manipulation data by deploying our devices "in the wild" like manufacturing factories, logistic centers to collect Tesla like data, use these data to train our model and then provide automation solutions to these industries.
companies.story: 这是做机器人操作方向的公司，目标是让机械手什么都能抓、什么都能操作。假如你是一家物流中心或工厂的主管，面对拣选、上料这些变化多端的活儿，固定编程的机械臂总是应付不来，而人工又越来越难招。Origami Robotics 同时做数据采集装置和高自由度直驱机械手，两者设计得完全匹配，从而消除 embodiment gap，把在真实场景采集的数据直接用于训练和部署。他们计划把设备放到工厂、物流中心这类真实环境里持续采集操作数据，再反过来为这些行业提供自动化方案。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，硬件与模型一起做是它值得看的地方。

companies.name: Arlo Industries
companies.originalOneLiner: Track drones and missiles without radars - Accurate, Passive, Scalable
companies.originalDescription: Arlo Industries is building a network of sensors that precisely tracks stealthy drones and aerial threats better than radars. This capability does not exist yet because traditional radars are built on past war doctrines designed to protect single, centralised assets. Modern warfare, however, demands wide-area, persistent coverage that is both passive and economically scalable. By utilising a mesh architecture, Arlo Industries unlocks unprecedented asymmetric economics. The network is fundamentally built to scale: the cost of adding sensors grows linearly, but the tracking accuracy increases exponentially, delivering highly resilient, persistent coverage for a fraction of the cost of legacy systems. Deo founded Arlo Industries after spending over 6 years in the Israeli defence ecosystem, where he lived through multiple conflicts and experienced the Iron Dome and other systems in action against ICBMs and the infamous Shahed drones. Learning exactly how these defence systems could be improved after a Shahed exploded close to his apartment, he built Arlo Industries around the core philosophy that conflict should be concise & precise. The people behind Arlo1 includes a PhD in drones and autonomy and military experts. Arlo Industries has actively showcased this technology directly to Ukrainian militaries on the frontlines, as well as to operators across Europe and the USA.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是防空探测硬件，用传感器网络追踪无人机和导弹。如果你负责一处关键设施的防护，传统雷达按过去集中保护单一目标的思路设计，面对低空、隐蔽、成群出现的小型目标，覆盖范围和成本都很难撑住。Arlo Industries 用网状架构组网，传感器数量增加时成本线性上升，追踪精度却指数级提升，从而以远低于传统系统的代价获得持续、被动、大范围的覆盖。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人且正在招聘，创始人曾在以色列防务领域工作六年多，经历过多次冲突。它值得看的是这种非对称成本结构在现实防务需求里的位置。

companies.name: Amera
companies.originalOneLiner: Automating claims processing workflows for health insurance payers.
companies.originalDescription: Amera automates claims processing for health insurance payers. We turn messy claim inputs (PDFs, bills, receipts, EDI and non-standard submissions) into structured data that plugs into existing systems. This cuts manual entry and exception handling, speeding up operations and reducing cost. We are already working with payers / plan administrators representing ~100k members, giving them access to more affordable care options.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是健康保险理赔流程自动化，服务的是保险支付方。假如你是一位理赔运营负责人，每天要处理成堆的 PDF、账单、收据以及各种格式不统一的提交材料，人工录入和异常处理把团队拖得又慢又贵。Amera 把这些杂乱的理赔输入转成结构化数据，直接接入现有系统，减少手工录入和例外处理，让运营更快、成本更低。它称已与代表约十万名会员的支付方和计划管理机构合作，帮助他们提供更可负担的医疗选择。它来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队十二人，值得关注的是它已经进入真实支付方的工作流。

companies.name: Control Seat
companies.originalOneLiner: AI that runs factories.
companies.originalDescription: Control Seat builds the hardware and software that helps industrial teams see, understand, and run their operations. Our platform creates one clear source of truth across the plant. It connects the systems teams already use, brings control, monitoring, history, and machine health together, and adds an intelligence layer that continuously watches for meaningful changes. Teams can understand what happened, catch problems earlier, and act before they become downtime. The result is fewer surprises, faster decisions, and less time spent piecing together information across disconnected tools. We work with manufacturers, utilities, energy companies, and other industrial operators modernizing existing facilities or building new ones.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是工厂运营软件与硬件，让人工智能帮工业团队看清并运行生产。想象你是一位工厂经理，控制系统、监控、历史数据和设备健康信息散落在好几套互不相通的工具里，出了问题只能靠人到处拼凑线索。Control Seat 把这些系统连起来，形成厂区内统一的真实视图，再加一层持续观察变化的智能，让团队弄清发生了什么、更早发现问题、在停机之前采取行动。他们服务的对象包括制造商、公用事业和能源公司，既有正在改造的老厂也有新建项目。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，工业现场的信息割裂本身就是值得看的理由。

readings.title: Show HN: Synthetic clickstream data for recommender cold-start
readings.story: 做推荐的产品经理大概都碰过这种尴尬：新产品刚上线，用户没留下几条行为记录，模型冷启动，推荐结果像在猜。于是有人开始琢磨，能不能先用合成出来的点击数据把模型喂起来。这条来自 Hacker News 的分享就落在这个问题上。值得读，是因为它代表技术社区正在关心的一种做法：用造出来的数据补真实数据的缺口。读的时候可以留意作者怎么描述数据的生成方式，以及他们如何判断合成数据在什么情况下可信、什么情况下会误导人。

readings.title: The Download: the claim shaking up AI and the internet’s agent problem
readings.story: 最近一两年，关于人工智能的说法越来越多，普通读者常常分不清哪些是真正的突破，哪些只是被反复转述的断言。与此同时，网络上的自动代理程序也在变多，它们替人浏览、下单、抓取信息，让网站运营方开始头疼。这期 Download 把这两件事放在一起讨论。它值得读的地方在于，能帮人看清一个说法是怎么被传播开的，以及自动代理给互联网带来的实际摩擦。读的时候不妨注意作者如何区分证据和推测，以及他们怎么判断谁在为这些问题买单。

readings.title: Spotify launches paid podcast memberships with perks beyond bonus content
readings.story: 播客听众大概都有过这种体验：喜欢一个节目，想多支持主播一点，却发现除了打赏没有别的通道。Spotify 这次推出付费播客会员，把权益扩展到额外内容之外，正是在回应这种需求。对做内容产品的人来说，这是一条值得留意的动向，因为它涉及平台怎么和创作者分钱、听众愿意为什么付费。读的时候可以看作者怎么拆解会员权益的设计，以及平台在吸引听众和照顾创作者之间做了哪些取舍。

companies.name: DeepReach Inc.
companies.originalOneLiner: Network for Physical AI Data Business
companies.originalDescription: Physical AI — robots and world models — is bottlenecked on one thing: diverse, real-world data at massive scale showing how humans actually do work in the physical world. It was never written down, and you can't buy it, because no one has ever captured it. Only real local experts, the people who do this work every day, can produce data this authentic and valuable. DeepReach builds the network that reaches them. We design and manufacture wearable stereo capture devices, then place them with local data partners who run collection as their own business — in warehouses, workshops, farms, kitchens and repair shops. They own the local relationships; we supply the hardware, the software platform, the quality pipeline and the payments. Anyone can run a data business. That structure is what produces diversity. Instead of thousands of hours inside one environment, we deliver hours spread across thousands of environments — which is what actually makes robot policies generalize. 475 devices in the field and 100+ data partners are live across 7 countries, adding new partners every week. They've collected nearly 150,000 clips in the past three months, with volume roughly doubling month over month. Our data is in production with multiple frontier model and robotics companies, and we're scaling to 10,000+ devices across 50 countries.
companies.story: 这是做物理世界人工智能数据网络的公司。想象你是一位仓库主管，你每天看着熟练工人分拣、搬运、处理异常，这些动作从没被完整记录下来，而训练机器人恰恰需要这种真实数据。DeepReach 设计并制造可穿戴立体采集设备，交给本地数据伙伴在仓库、车间、农场、厨房和修理店等地开展采集，伙伴自己经营本地关系，公司提供硬件、软件平台、质量流程和结算。它值得关注的地方在于，这套结构让数据来源分散到大量真实场景，而不是在单一环境里堆几千小时，公司目前六人，正在招聘，属于 YC 夏季 2026 批次。可穿戴设备把采集能力直接放进工人身上的传感器和随身场景里，这是手机应用做不到的。

companies.name: Autumn
companies.originalOneLiner: The people-intelligence company.
companies.originalDescription: Autumn builds research agents that answer questions about people and companies at scale. These AI agents are powered by a live index of over 1 billion people, 100 million companies, and state-of-the-art web research tools. Autumn is already in production with enterprise teams at Brex, Rippling, PostHog across sourcing, enrichment, and identity-verification workflows. We are a small, highly-technical team. Our vision is to be the search engine that agents use when they need to understand people, their networks, and professional lives.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是人与公司的情报检索。假如你是一位销售主管，今天要快速摸清一批目标公司的关键人物和背景，靠人工搜索既慢又容易漏。Autumn 构建研究智能体，用超过十亿人物、一亿家公司的实时索引和网络研究工具，回答关于人和公司的问题。它已进入生产环境，服务 Brex、Rippling、PostHog 等企业团队，用于寻源、信息补充和身份核验流程。团队只有四人，正在招聘，属于 YC 冬季 2026 批次，它想成为智能体理解人及其职业网络时使用的搜索引擎。

companies.name: Overshoot
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Infra for real-time vision applications
companies.originalDescription: Overshoot makes it easy for developers to build and run real-time vision applications. AI can see and understand the physical world. This unlocks new applications in physical security, safety, gaming, robotics and general consumer products. Soon, video agents will watch your home and your pet when you’re away. However, existing platforms make it painful for developers to build these real-time applications. Slow inference. Limited model availability. Break at scale. Overshoot solves this. Today, 300+ developers connect live video feeds to the largest collection of Vision Language Models with 3 lines of code. And get responses in less than 200ms. 10x faster than any existing inference platform. Zero infra headache. Our moat is focus. Image and Video are fundamentally different modalities from text. By focusing on them, we are able to make strong technical leaps from codec, streaming protocols to inference engines. Younes and Zakaria are cousins. Zakaria graduated top of his class at LSE and MIT, and later built low-latency high-throughput pricing systems (surge) at Uber and inference engines at Meta. He previously built and sold a software product and won several prominent AI hackathons. Younes was a founding engineer at Cosmonio (later acquired by Intel). He built a training and serving Computer Vision platform from scratch. He witnessed firsthand customers abandoning traditional Computer Vision because it lacked the “general” intelligence LLMs have today. Together we’ve shipped large-scale systems and know where they break.
companies.story: 这是为实时视觉应用提供人工智能基础设施的公司。如果你是一位工程负责人，正想把监控摄像头接入模型做实时识别，你会发现推理慢、可用模型少、规模一大就出问题。Overshoot 让开发者用三行代码把实时视频流接到规模最大的视觉语言模型集合，响应时间低于两百毫秒，比现有推理平台快十倍，无需自己操心基础设施。目前已有三百多名开发者在使用，团队五人，属于 YC 冬季 2026 批次。它的思路是专注图像和视频这两种与文本根本不同的模态，从编解码、流传输等底层做技术突破。

companies.name: IMPACT Drones
companies.originalOneLiner: Air Defense as a Service for Civilian Infrastructure.
companies.originalDescription: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in sealed containers. The box sits at the site it protects, data centers, power grids, airports, bases, with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard vision that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $30k threats; ours cost less than the threat and scale with the swarm, the same class of interceptor already downing Shahed drones over Ukraine. Sites subscribe to protection instead of buying missiles, hardware, reloads and monitoring included: Air Defense as a Service. 180M+ USD in signed letters of intent.
companies.story: 这是把空中防御做成订阅服务的公司。想象你负责一座数据中心或变电站的安保，某天传感器发现一架廉价无人机靠近，而传统拦截手段一发成本上百万美元。IMPACT 制造装在密封箱里的自主拦截无人机，箱子就放在受保护地点，无需现场人员，传感器提示后拦截机穿破箱盖起飞，靠机载视觉在 GPS 受干扰时仍能撞向目标。它的单次成本低于来袭威胁本身，客户按月订阅防护，硬件、补弹和监控都包含在内。公司两人，正在招聘，属于 YC 夏季 2026 批次，已签下超过一亿八千万美元的意向书。

companies.name: Boost Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Robots for the inspection and maintenance of data centers
companies.originalDescription: Boost Robotics is building autonomous mobile manipulation robots to remotely perform manual tasks in data centers. The surge in AI applications is pushing data centers to scale faster than they can manage, leading to suboptimal operations and staffing shortages amid rising power and compute demands. We save data centers millions in insurance premiums and SLA violations by increasing the frequency of inspection and maintenance while reducing the time it takes to triage and address failures.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是数据中心巡检与维护机器人。如果你是一位数据中心运营负责人，你会看到人工智能应用推着机房越建越快，运维却跟不上，人手短缺，电力和算力需求还在涨，故障排查又慢。Boost Robotics 研发自主移动操作机器人，远程完成原本需要人工到场的任务，提高巡检和维护频率，缩短发现和处理故障的时间。按它的说法，这能为数据中心省下数百万美元的保险费用和服务水平违约损失。团队两人，属于 YC 春季 2025 批次，机器人形态意味着能力要真正进入机房现场，而不只是屏幕上的软件。

companies.name: Opalite Health
companies.originalOneLiner: Helping Healthcare Providers Speak Any Language
companies.originalDescription: Opalite makes it easy for healthcare providers to communicate with non-English speaking patients. We’re built to work inside existing clinical workflows, so providers can communicate in real time without waiting for an interpreter or delaying care. Opalite is available instantly, 24/7, and replaces traditional interpretation services with software that’s more reliable and saves millions of dollars per year. We've built a voice AI system that is the safest, most compliant, and most accurate medical interpreter in the world.
companies.story: 这是帮医疗机构跨语言沟通的公司。假如你是一位诊所运营负责人，今天来了一位不说英语的患者，等口译员要拖时间，不等又怕沟通出错。Opalite 做的是医疗口译语音人工智能，嵌进现有临床流程，医生可以实时和患者交流，不必等口译员或推迟诊疗，全天候可用。它用软件替代传统口译服务，公司称更可靠，每年能省下数百万美元。团队三人，正在招聘，属于 YC 冬季 2026 批次，它强调自己是更安全、更合规也更准确的医疗口译系统，这类场景对准确和合规的要求本身就值得关注。

companies.name: Mbodi AI

companies.name: RonanRx Inc.
companies.originalOneLiner: Full Stack Pharmaceutical Company for Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
companies.originalDescription: RonanRX is a full-stack pharmaceutical company, starting with personalized peptides and GLP-1s. In our first 10 weeks, we went from having no pharmacy to being licensed in 33 states. Since launch, we’ve grown 50% week over week. We manufacture the medications ourselves, sell directly to patients, and eliminate the layers of middlemen that make prescription drugs more expensive. What makes this possible is AI. Traditional pharmaceutical companies are built to manufacture one drug for millions of people. RonanRX is purpose-built to personalize treatment for each patient: different biology, different response, different dose. Patients come directly to RonanRX or through doctors using our platform. Every patient completes our medical intake, meets with a licensed doctor through our telehealth platform, and receives a personalized prescription when appropriate. From there, we manufacture the medication ourselves and deliver it directly to the patient. Labs, wearables, medical history, treatment response, and other health data feed back into the platform so doctors can continuously refine treatment over time. Before AI, doing this for every patient at scale was impossible. We didn't invent the demand we are seeing. 80 Million people are on a GLP-1 and millions more are using Peptides. We're building a better way to manufacture, personalize, prescribe, and deliver them. Our founders have built and exited multiple companies, raised more than $100M, built a $50M U.S. medical manufacturing business, and spent years developing peptide therapeutics at companies including Eli Lilly and AbbVie. We’re just getting started with peptides and GLP-1s. Next comes hormone therapy and the rest of personalized medicine.

readings.title: Gemini AI Suite – Zero-Cost Next.js 14, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Stripe Starter
readings.story: 很多独立开发者和小团队想验证一个产品想法时，最先卡住的往往不是写代码，而是从零搭出一套能跑起来的东西：前端框架、模型接口、收款流程，每一样都要花时间。这条在技术社区被讨论的入口，正好落在这个场景里。它值得读，是因为它把几个常见部件放进同一个起点，让人看到一个人或小团队可以怎样更快走到能演示、能收钱的那一步。读的时候可以留意作者如何取舍：哪些部分直接复用现成方案，哪些地方留了扩展空间，以及这种打包方式在真实项目里会省掉什么、又会带来什么新的依赖。

readings.title: Beyond the patch: Protecting your NetScaler gateway against future vulnerabilities
readings.story: 很多团队在网关这类设备上做安全，习惯是等出事再补：哪个漏洞被利用，就打哪个补丁。可补丁总是慢一步，攻击者换条路，同样的入口还会再被打开。运维和安全的人大概都经历过这种循环：修完一处，心里并不踏实，因为不知道下一次会从哪来。这篇文章值得读，是因为它把注意力从单个漏洞挪到了这类网关本身该怎么防。读的时候不妨留意作者怎么拆问题：是先看攻击面有哪些，还是先看已有防护留了哪些缝。也可以看他如何判断取舍，哪些做法是短期止血，哪些是长期加固，以及他有没有指出流程里真正卡住的地方。

readings.title: Apple updates guidelines to ban nudify apps masquerading as regular apps to pass review
readings.story: 做应用审核的人常会遇到一个尴尬：规则写得清清楚楚，可总有人把违规功能藏进看起来正常的应用里，先混过审核，上线后再露出真面目。用户投诉来了，平台才发现规则和实际执行之间有空档。这篇报道讲的正是苹果更新审核指南，要挡住那些伪装成普通应用、实为生成裸露图像的工具。它值得读，是因为这类猫鼠游戏几乎每个做内容平台或应用商店的人都会碰到。读的时候可以看作者怎么梳理规则的调整：禁令落在哪一层，是禁止功能本身，还是禁止伪装手法。也可以留意它如何呈现各方的判断，以及这类更新能不能真正堵住审核流程里的那个缺口。

companies.name: Workers IO
companies.originalOneLiner: Simulation environments for verifying mission-critical software
companies.originalDescription: Workers IO is building deterministic simulation environments to verify mission-critical software. We run your entire system through millions of production scenarios and prove that its properties hold in every one. The problem: Coding agents write code faster than teams can review it. At the same time, software and the infrastructure under it grow more complex every year. Tests only checks a few cases someone wrote, in isolation, in an environment that does not match production. Making the most expensive failures reach production first. Our solution: We run your system unmodified in our simulation environments, against network partitions, disk failures, crashes, and clock drift. We build those fault models for you and verify every promise across millions of scenarios. Because these simulations are deterministic, every failure is perfectly reproducible. No one writes scenarios by hand, so verification becomes a compute problem.
companies.story: 这是做软件验证基础设施的公司。想象你是一个工程负责人，团队里的智能体写代码的速度已经超过人工审查的速度，而单元测试只覆盖了别人手写的少数场景，跑在一个和生产环境并不一致的地方，于是最贵的故障总是先跑到线上。Workers IO 把整个系统原样放进确定性模拟环境里，让它经历网络分区、磁盘故障、进程崩溃和时钟漂移，在上百万个场景中验证各项承诺，因为模拟是确定性的，每次失败都能精确复现。它属于 YC 秋季批次，团队只有两人并且正在招聘，值得关注的是它正面回应了智能体写代码带来的验证缺口。

companies.name: Standard Physics

companies.originalDescription: Standard Physics (formerly Inviscid AI) builds AI that does real physics. Most AI tools approximate physical behavior and get it wrong in ways engineers can’t see. Ours run actual numerical solvers, so the results are accurate enough to make real engineering decisions on. We have three products built on one engine. Reynolds runs computational fluid dynamics for you. An engineer describes the flow in plain language, and Reynolds writes the OpenFOAM case, builds the mesh, runs the solver, and returns the figures, the numbers, and a case they can rerun. It’s open source. Archimedes searches the design itself. Swarms of agents try thousands of layouts in parallel, simulate each one through Reynolds, keep what the physics rewards, and redraw the search space when the best answer was never in the original plan. We sell it as outcome-based engineering: customers pay for a better design, not for compute. Inviscid AI (now a product!) points the same engine at a running building. It holds a data center within its thermal limits in real time, computed continuously from live telemetry. Our platform optimizes airflow patterns and ventilation strategies to eliminate dead zones, improve air distribution, and reduce the load on mechanical systems. On the energy side, we minimize HVAC power consumption, reduce cooling costs, and lower overall operational expenses while maintaining optimal thermal comfort and indoor air quality. We work with hardware startups and engineering teams on data center cooling, drones, energy systems, piping, and electronics. Reynolds earns engineers’ trust in daily use, and Archimedes and Inviscid AI turn that trust into large contracts.
companies.story: 这是做工程物理仿真的公司。如果你是一名负责流体设计的工程师，过去想跑一次计算流体力学，得自己写算例、划网格、调求解器，花掉好几天。Standard Physics 的做法是让人工智能驱动真正的数值求解器，而不是近似物理行为，工程师用日常语言描述流动，Reynolds 就写好算例、建好网格、跑完求解并返回图表、数字和可复现的算例，这个产品是开源的。另一个产品 Archimedes 则让成群的智能体并行尝试上千种布局，用物理结果筛选，再重新划定搜索空间，并按结果收费。它属于 YC 冬季批次，两人团队，卖点是结果准确到能支撑真实工程决策。

companies.name: Hemlock
companies.originalOneLiner: Force-sensing wristband for training robotic AI
companies.originalDescription: Every serious robotics lab is bottlenecked on the same thing: demonstration data. The field has converged on egocentric video and hand pose as the substrate, and both are now cheap to collect at scale. What neither of them contains is force. A video of someone picking up an egg and a video of someone picking up a rock are nearly identical in pixel space and nearly identical in joint angles. They differ almost entirely in a quantity nobody is recording. Policies trained without it learn geometry and inherit no sense of touch. Hemlock closes that gap at the source. Our device, the Bracelet, is a wrist-worn surface EMG band that reads the electrical activity of the forearm muscles that actually drive the hand, which means it recovers contraction force directly rather than inferring it from motion. This distinction is the whole thesis: force cannot be reconstructed downstream of kinematics, because a hand squeezing hard isometrically and a hand resting can occupy the identical pose. Muscle signal is the only non-invasive channel that separates them.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是训练机器人人工智能用的力感知硬件。想象你是一个机器人实验室的研究员，手上有大量第一视角视频和手部姿态数据，可一段捏起鸡蛋的视频和一段抓起石头的视频在像素和关节角度上几乎一样，缺的正是力。Hemlock 的 Bracelet 是一只戴在手腕上的表面肌电手环，直接读取驱动手部的前臂肌肉电活动，从而还原出收缩力，而不是从动作反推。它不只是手机应用，而是把传感能力放进随身佩戴的设备里，从源头补上缺失的那一维数据。它属于 YC 秋季批次，目前是一人团队，值得看的是它瞄准了机器人学习里公认的数据瓶颈。

companies.name: Volaren Inc.
companies.originalOneLiner: Turning Ideas into Trades. Volaren puts the hedge fund in the hands…
companies.originalDescription: Turning ideas into trades. Every great investment starts as an idea about the world. Institutions have teams of analysts turning those ideas into positions. Volaren is that team, processing data through fundamentals and quantitative models that can be personalized with AI. Turn your views into trades, portfolios, and back-testable frameworks and strategies, and Volaren stays with you from there, showing you what's actually driving each position and what it means for your next move.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是把投资想法变成交易的工具。假如你是一个有自己的市场判断、却请不起分析师团队的独立投资者，你看到某个行业趋势，却不知道该怎么落成具体仓位、怎么回测、怎么跟踪。Volaren 用基本面与量化模型处理数据，并可以按个人偏好用人工智能定制，把你的观点转成交易、组合和可回测的框架与策略，之后还会持续告诉你每个仓位真正由什么驱动、对下一步意味着什么。它属于 YC 秋季批次，四人团队正在招聘。它值得关注的地方在于，把过去只属于机构的分析能力交到个人手里，正是它想做的事。

companies.name: Evergrove
companies.originalOneLiner: Instant healthcare for all, starting with work comp
companies.originalDescription: We've built voice agents for the largest work comp managed care orgs and specialist PT networks in the country, making >500K calls annually and accelerating the speed at which they coordinate care. On average, our customers see a 40% increase in workflow completion, 10x decrease in cycle times, and >60% reduction in cost. We think voice agents are the starting point for solving slow and fragmented care coordination in this market. Companies that manage an injured worker's care rely on short-staffed contact centres and archaic methods of info exchange: phone, fax, and email. Every delay along the path of care leads to slower rehab of the injured worker, lower throughput for providers, and higher expense for the insurer/employer.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是工伤理赔场景下的医疗协调。如果你是一家管理受伤工人护理的机构里的运营负责人，你会知道协调有多慢：人手不足的呼叫中心靠电话、传真和邮件来回传信息，每耽误一步，工人康复就更慢，服务方吞吐更低，保险公司和雇主支出更高。Evergrove 用语音智能体替这些机构打电话协调护理，团队称已服务全美最大的几家工伤管理护理机构和专科康复网络，每年完成超过五十万通电话，客户平均工作流完成率提升四成，周期缩短十倍，成本下降六成以上。它属于 YC 夏季批次，两人团队，把语音智能体当作解决这个碎片化市场的起点。

readings.title: Verse from the waste land:Rotterdam's poetic bin lorries granted cultural status
readings.story: 城市里每天都有垃圾车经过，大多数人不会多看一眼。但如果有人把诗句印在车身上，让收垃圾这件事变得有点不一样，会发生什么？鹿特丹就做了这样的尝试，还给这些车申请了文化地位。读这篇文章，可以看看一个看似不起眼的公共设施如何被重新赋予意义，以及人们为什么愿意为这种改变买单。注意作者如何描述这些车从实用工具变成城市符号的过程，以及文化认定背后有哪些实际考量。

readings.title: [AINews] High Taste Testers Ep. 1
readings.story: 做产品的人常常要判断一个东西好不好，但 taste 这件事很难量化。尤其当 人工智能 生成的内容越来越多，谁来当那个有品味的人就成了新问题。Latent Space 这期节目聊的就是高品味测试者，听起来像在讨论审美，其实背后是 人工智能 产品如何评估质量、如何建立标准。读的时候可以留意他们怎么定义品味，以及这种判断如何影响模型训练和产品设计。

readings.title: Mark Wahlberg wants to take on the longevity-startup crowd with an affordable gym concept
readings.story: 长寿和健身最近成了创业热点，各种高价会员和科技感十足的概念层出不穷。但 Mark Wahlberg 想做的却是 affordable gym，把价格拉下来。这背后是一个常见的商业问题：当市场都在往高端走，平价路线还有没有机会？读这篇可以看作者如何拆解这个创业想法，它面对的是哪群人，以及为什么在长寿概念火热的当下，便宜反而成了一种差异化。

companies.name: Graphify Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: On-device Knowledge Graph engine for Enterprise Software
companies.originalDescription: Graphify is a Knowledge Graph control plane for enterprise software. The open-source tool has 116K+ GitHub stars and 6.5M+ downloads, and is used in production by engineers at Shopify, Datadog, JP Morgan, American Express, Harvey, Automation Anywhere, and Vanguard. On top of that graph, our enterprise layer reviews every pull request and formally verifies each code change: it proves the new behavior matches the old, or hands back the exact input that breaks it. That makes it built for the changes teams fear most, like refactors, framework upgrades, and large-scale migrations, where you need proof that nothing broke, not a guess. The graph updates itself as the code changes and keeps context instead of forgetting it, so your whole team and their coding agents work from one shared, always-current view of the codebase instead of a thousand private threads. It runs entirely inside your perimeter, fully air-gapped on-premise or self-hosted in your own cloud, so no code or data ever leaves your environment.
companies.story: 这是做企业软件知识图谱控制层的公司。假如你是大型团队的工程负责人，今天最怕的不是写新功能，而是做重构、升级框架或大规模迁移，因为没人能证明旧行为没被改坏。Graphify 在代码图谱之上加了一层企业能力，它会审查每一个代码合并请求，并形式化验证每处改动，要么证明新行为与旧行为一致，要么直接交回导致失败的具体输入。图谱会随代码变化自动更新，保留上下文而不是遗忘，让整个团队和他们的编码智能体共享一份始终最新的代码视图。它的开源工具在 GitHub 上有一万六千多颗星和六百五十万次以上下载，Shopify、Datadog、摩根大通、美国运通、Harvey、Automation Anywhere 和 Vanguard 的工程师都在生产环境使用，还入选了 YC 夏季 2026 批次，这些都说明它切入的正是团队最不敢碰的改动场景。

companies.name: Cotool
companies.originalOneLiner: Security operations optimized for agents.
companies.originalDescription: Cotool builds AI agents and the infrastructure around them to help security teams detect threats, investigate alerts, hunt for attacks, and respond. Our agents work across a team's security tools and data. They investigate alerts, write and tune Python detections, and turn threat intelligence into hunts and new coverage. Teams can customize agents around their workflows, inspect the evidence, edit detection logic, and bring humans in when judgment or approval matters. Underneath the agents, Cotool provides log storage and search built for their workloads, with access to data where it already lives. The goal is to give security teams more capacity to defend their companies as their environments and workloads grow. Teams at Ramp, EliseAI, ClickHouse, Legora, and many more use Cotool.
companies.story: 这是做安全运营智能体与配套基础设施的公司。想象你是一名安全分析师，早上一打开电脑就是几十条告警，要逐个查日志、写检测规则、追踪威胁线索，人手永远不够。Cotool 的智能体可以跨团队已有的安全工具和数据工作，调查告警、编写和调优 Python 检测规则，把威胁情报变成狩猎行动和新的覆盖范围。团队能按自己的流程定制智能体，检查证据，修改检测逻辑，在需要判断或批准时把人拉进来。底层还提供为这类工作负载打造的日志存储和搜索，并可以直接访问数据原本所在的位置。Ramp、EliseAI、ClickHouse、Legora 等团队已经在用，它入选了 YC 春季 2025 批次，团队八人且正在招聘，方向是让安全团队随着环境和负载增长获得更多防守容量。

companies.name: Manicule
companies.originalOneLiner: AgentRel — Devrel For Agents
companies.originalDescription: Manicule does AgentRel. We get companies discovered and used by AI agents. Think DevRel, rebuilt for a world where agents make all the decisions. We own developer documentation and technical content across social channels, end-to-end. We've grown 100% MoM over the last three months to $53K in monthly revenue, with customers like Supermemory, Greptile, Reducto, and Mastra. Getting discovered and used by agents is its own job now, and the market for it is broken. The SEO/GEO SaaS tools just show you data like where you rank in AI answers. The agencies are slow and lack know-how with agents. The one person who could own all of it end-to-end, a DevRel, is nearly impossible to hire: our customers have had roles open for months at $300K+ and still can't find anyone good. We solve all these gaps. Naman has been doing fractional DevRel since he was 13, working with companies like PromptLayer, Brightdata, and Courier.com. Shreyans has been building since 14 — he built an AI app that hit App Store Productivity Trending within a month, and was the founding engineer at Supermemory. We met in high school and have built multiple startups together since.
companies.story: 这是做智能体时代开发者关系的公司。如果你负责一家开发工具公司的增长，你会发现一个新麻烦：越来越多的技术选型由智能体完成，可你的文档、技术内容和社交渠道没人系统打理，传统搜索引擎优化工具只给你看排名数据，代理机构又慢又不懂智能体。Manicule 端到端接手开发者文档和技术内容，目标就是让公司被智能体发现并使用。它过去三个月月度经常性收入增长百分之一百，达到每月五万三千美元，客户包括 Supermemory、Greptile、Reducto 和 Mastra。它入选了 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队七人且正在招聘。这个场景值得看，是因为客户为这类岗位开出三十万美元以上年薪、挂了几个月仍招不到合适的人，而让智能体发现并使用产品已经变成一项独立且供给稀缺的工作。

companies.name: Faraday
companies.originalOneLiner: Agents running industrial enterprises from back office to shop floor
companies.originalDescription: Faraday builds industrial AI that learns how enterprises operate and executes long-horizon, multi-step tasks from the back office to the shop floor. We sit on top of fragmented systems of record, coordinating work across existing software and teams. We combine operating procedures, enterprise data, and expert feedback to capture the rules and judgment behind complex processes. In customer-specific RL environments, we optimize the agent harness around each company’s systems, constraints, approvals, and exceptions. We’re connecting to industrial hardware to bring live production data into the same feedback loop. Human corrections, machine data, and operating results help improve how agents plan and execute future work.
companies.story: 这是做工业人工智能的公司，让智能体从后台办公室一直跑到车间现场。假如你是一家工厂的运营负责人，每天要在多个互不相通的老系统之间协调生产、审批和异常处理，很多规则和判断只存在老师傅的脑子里。Faraday 坐在这些碎片化记录系统之上，协调现有软件和团队之间的工作，把操作流程、企业数据和专家反馈结合起来，捕捉复杂流程背后的规则与判断。它会在针对每家客户的强化学习环境里，围绕该公司的系统、约束、审批和例外来优化智能体。它还在连接工业硬件，把实时生产数据带入同一个反馈循环，人的纠正、机器数据和运营结果都会帮助智能体改进未来的计划与执行。它入选了 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，切入的是后台到车间这条长链条。

companies.name: Operon
companies.originalOneLiner: Agentic data layer for manufacturing & process industries.
companies.originalDescription: Operon is the data intelligence layer for heavy industry. We ingest the messy documents a plant runs on (P&IDs, schematics, datasheets, scans) and turn them into one structured, queryable model of the facility. On top of it, engineers query their plant in natural language and build agentic workflows for safety, compliance, and design.
companies.story: 这是做重工业数据智能层的公司。如果你是一名工厂工程师，想弄清楚某条管线或某个设备的历史参数，往往要翻一堆管道仪表图、原理图、数据表和扫描件，信息散落在纸面和不同系统里。Operon 把这些工厂赖以运转的杂乱文档吃进来，转成一份结构化、可查询的设施模型。在这之上，工程师可以用自然语言向自己的工厂提问，并为安全、合规和设计搭建智能体工作流。它入选了 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队规模信号为零且正在招聘，方向是把重工业里最难整理的文档变成可用的数据底座。这个场景值得看，是因为工厂里大量关键知识仍锁在非结构化图纸和表格中，谁能把它变成可查询的模型，谁就握住了后续自动化的入口。

companies.name: Vexo
companies.originalOneLiner: An AI bracelet that remembers your day and acts before you ask.
companies.originalDescription: Every AI today waits for a prompt. Vexo already has the context: the restaurant a friend mentioned, the intro you promised, the idea you had on a walk. It turns what it hears into private memories and acts on them, booking the table, sending the follow-up, and ordering the groceries through the apps you already use. It's a woven bracelet with a microphone and health sensors. No screen, and nothing to open. Vexo never keeps your audio. Only you can see your memories, and you can delete them anytime.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能手环的公司，把能力放进一条编织手环，而不是做成一个手机应用。想象你是一位会议很多的咨询顾问，朋友在饭桌上提到一家餐厅，你答应帮人做介绍，散步时又冒出一个点子，可这些事一转头就忘了，而今天的助手都要你先开口提问。Vexo 手环带麦克风和健康传感器，没有屏幕，也不用打开任何东西，它把听到的内容变成私密记忆并据此行动，帮你订餐厅、发跟进消息、通过你已经在用的应用下单买菜。它不保留你的音频，只有你能看到自己的记忆，也可以随时删除。它入选了 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队三人。值得关注的地方在于，它试图让设备先拥有上下文再主动行动，这正是纯软件助手很难做到的随身场景。

companies.name: Denta
companies.originalOneLiner: Fortune 500 Dental Benefits for Startups
companies.originalDescription: Starting with dental benefits, we are relentlessly simplifying the process for patients to receive better coverage at a lower cost by putting the buying power back into the hand of the individual.
companies.story: 这是做牙科保险福利的金融科技与医疗健康公司。假如你是一家初创公司的运营或人事负责人，想给团队配一份像样的牙科福利，却常被复杂的方案、报销流程和高昂成本劝退，员工看牙时也搞不清自己到底能报多少。Denta 从牙科福利入手，把购买力交回个人手中，持续简化流程，让患者以更低成本获得更好的保障。它入选了 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队规模信号为一且正在招聘。这个场景值得看，是因为牙科福利长期是大公司才配得起的复杂产品，而初创公司和个体在其中的议价与选择空间一直很小，谁能把这条链路做简单，谁就可能改变个人获得保障的方式。

companies.name: OctaPulse
companies.originalOneLiner: Building the robotics layer for seafood production
companies.originalDescription: OctaPulse is building the robotics layer for seafood production. Aquaculture is the fastest-growing food sector and already produces more seafood than commercial fishing, yet the people who breed and process fish still make thousands of decisions a day with almost no data about the fish in front of them, and much of the most important work is still done by hand, one fish at a time. We put cameras where fish are already handled, turn every image into measurements, and give farms and plants the tools to act on them. Today that is two products: Phenotyping, which measures every fish for shape, size and condition and links it to its family for breeding decisions, and Digital Twin, which places cameras on processing lines and farm sites onto the floor plan with live views, automatic counts and a built-in AI assistant. The same per-fish measurements are the foundation for Plant Robotics: robot cells that handle whole fish on the processing line, working alongside the people there. Fish are wet, slippery, soft and never the same twice, which is exactly why this work is still manual and why it needs measurement-driven robots built for food plants rather than rigid grippers and tabletop demos. We are now selecting processing plants for the first pilots on real lines. We signed a 6-figure paid pilot with the largest trout producer in the United States, and every deployment adds labeled images to a proprietary multi-species dataset that improves our models across species and becomes the brain for autonomous seafood production.
companies.story: 这是做海鲜生产机器人层的公司，把视觉能力放到鱼被处理的现场。如果你是一家水产养殖场的负责人，每天要为数以千计的鱼做育种和加工决定，却几乎没有任何关于眼前这条鱼的数据，很多最重要的工作仍是一条一条手工完成。OctaPulse 把摄像头装在鱼本来就会被处理的位置，把每张图像变成测量数据，再给养殖场和加工厂提供据此行动的工具。目前有两个产品，表型测量会记录每条鱼的形状、大小和状况，并关联到它的家系用于育种决策；数字孪生则把摄像头放到加工线和养殖场平面图上，提供实时画面、自动计数和内置人工智能助手。同样的逐鱼测量数据也是工厂机器人的基础。它入选了 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队两人且正在招聘，切入的是增长最快却数据最稀缺的食品 sector。

companies.name: Archangel Health
companies.originalOneLiner: Infra to make AI safe enough to practice medicine
companies.originalDescription: Archangel Health builds the infrastructure to post-train and evaluate medical AI: RL environments inside real de-identified EHRs, physician-verified training data, and benchmarks that test clinical reasoning on hard cases. Frontier labs and medical AI companies use it today, and we're now moving toward post-training open-source models for health systems on their own data and their own physicians' judgment
companies.story: 这是做医疗人工智能基础设施的公司，目标是让人工智能安全到可以真正行医。假如你是一家医院负责临床人工智能落地的研究员，你想用真实病例测试模型，却发现缺少贴近真实电子病历的训练环境、缺少医生核验的数据，也没有能考住临床推理的基准。Archangel Health 构建的正是这些：在真实去标识化电子病历里的强化学习环境、由医生核验的训练数据，以及在疑难病例上测试临床推理的基准。前沿实验室和医疗人工智能公司今天已经在使用它，公司正走向为卫生系统用其自有数据和自家医生判断来后训练开源模型。它入选了 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人。值得关注的地方在于，医疗人工智能缺的往往不是模型本身，而是能证明它安全可用的那套基础设施。

companies.name: Scout
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-powered student information system for K-12 schools
companies.originalDescription: The student information system (SIS) is the core system of record in every K-12 school. It tracks students, attendance, grades, schedules, staff, and more - kind of like the ERP for schools. Legacy SIS providers do just about that, and not much more. School districts layer dozens of tools on top of their SIS to fill in the gaps. Scout is an AI-powered student information system that automates school- and district-wide busywork, from day-to-day operations like attendance tracking to annual compliance reports. Our mission is to help school districts run like high-performing organizations, enabling them to provide high-quality, personalized instruction to every student.
companies.story: 这是做 K 到 12 学校学生信息系统的公司，相当于学校的企业管理系统。如果你是一所学校的教务负责人，每天要处理考勤、成绩、排课和人员信息，还要在学年末赶出一堆合规报告，而老系统只能记录这些基础数据，学区只好在它上面再叠几十个工具来补窟窿。Scout 用人工智能驱动学生信息系统，把从日常考勤到年度合规报告这类校务和学区事务自动化。它的使命是帮学区像高效组织一样运转，从而为每个学生提供高质量、个性化的教学。它入选了 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队八人且正在招聘。这个场景值得看，是因为学生信息系统是每所学校真正的记录核心，一旦这里被自动化，学区里大量分散工具的重复劳动就有了被收拢的可能。

readings.title: Nile Delta farmer finds Ramesses II statues
readings.story: 在农田里翻土、修水渠的时候，谁也不会想到脚下埋着三千年前的东西。这类发现之所以总能引起讨论，是因为它提醒我们：很多看起来普通的日常场景，底下藏着完全不同的历史层次。技术社区会转这条新闻，未必是因为考古本身，而是因为它触到了一个共同的好奇心：偶然的发现如何被识别、被确认、被赋予意义。读的时候可以留意农夫发现雕像之后发生了什么，谁来判断它是什么，判断的依据又是什么。这个过程其实和很多工作里的情形相似：一个信号出现了，真正难的是确认它到底意味着什么。

readings.title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
readings.story: 当一款智能设备卖到七十五美元，很多原本不会考虑这类产品的人会开始动心。对做产品的人来说，这个价格点值得注意，因为它把选择从“要不要买一个新鲜玩意”变成了“顺手添一件小东西”。亚马逊这次推出两款个人 人工智能 设备，背后的问题不只是硬件本身，而是人们愿不愿意让一个设备常驻在身边，替自己处理一些琐碎的事。读的时候可以看作者怎么描述这两款设备的定位差异，以及它把哪些使用场景说清楚了、哪些还含糊。价格降下来之后，真正决定成败的往往不是功能清单，而是日常里用不用得上。

readings.title: Cybersecurity Investors Put $6.8B To Work In The Third Quarter, Mostly In Larger Rounds
readings.story: 做安全方向的人这几年常有一种感觉：需求一直在，但钱进来的方式变了。第三季度有六十八亿美元投进网络安全，而且大多集中在金额更大的轮次里，这个结构本身就值得琢磨。对创业者来说，这意味着早期小步融资可能更难，对投资人来说，则意味着他们更愿意把钱压在已经看得出轮廓的公司上。读的时候可以留意作者怎么区分这些大额轮次，钱流向了哪一类公司，是防守型的基础设施，还是和 人工智能 相关的新方向。看清钱往哪里走，往往比看总金额更能说明这个行业正在往哪边偏。

companies.name: Visibl Semiconductors
companies.originalOneLiner: Custom silicon for power electronics
companies.originalDescription: Visibl Semiconductors makes custom silicon accessible to hardware companies, starting with power electronics. We are an AI-native custom-silicon design partner that cuts ASIC development cost and timeline on mature nodes, helping teams deliver better performance and lower BOM cost. We work with data-center and AI-infrastructure power, motor drives, industrial automation and robotics, industrial power supplies and conversion, battery systems and e-mobility powertrains, EV charging, solar, energy storage, grid power, HVAC, heat pumps, and appliances. V1 boards built from off-the-shelf parts are great for getting to market quickly, but scaling to v2+ volume requires optimizing cost, size, and manufacturability. Visibl folds those parts into custom silicon built around the product: a simpler BOM, reclaimed board space, fewer supply constraints, and automation-ready assembly. We manage the full path from architecture and design through verification, fabrication, packaging, and production-ready silicon, working alongside hardware teams so they do not need an in-house chip team.
companies.story: 这是做定制芯片设计的公司，方向是功率电子。假如你是一家做数据中心电源的硬件工程负责人，第一版产品用现成零件拼出来卖得不错，可要放量时发现成本、体积和供货都卡住了。Visibl 把那些分立零件收进一颗围绕产品定制的芯片里，让物料清单更简单、板子更小、供货更稳。它值得关注是因为它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队只有三人，正在招聘，而且切的是人工智能基础设施供电、电机驱动、工业自动化这些真实需求。

companies.name: Ploid
companies.originalOneLiner: The people data company for the agent era
companies.originalDescription: Ploid is the AI-native people data infrastructure for building products, workflows, and agents around people. We’ve built an index of 2B+ people across professional and social sources, with the infrastructure to search, resolve, enrich, and retrieve up-to-date information about anyone on demand. Through Ploid’s API, CLI, and MCP, developers and companies can search for people, enrich profiles, find emails and phone numbers, resolve identities across different data points, and access the broader web context associated with a person. Unlike traditional people databases that rely primarily on static records, Ploid is designed for AI-native workflows. We combine our people index with real-time retrieval and entity resolution so data can be refreshed and expanded at the moment it is requested. Ploid can power everything from sales and recruiting products to customer intelligence, identity resolution, trust and safety, and AI agents that need reliable information about people. Instead of building and maintaining dozens of data integrations yourself, Ploid gives you one infrastructure layer for people data. 2B+ people. One API. Built for AI.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是人员数据基础设施，面向智能体时代。想象你是一名销售开发代表，每天要在网上翻找潜在客户的职位、邮箱和社交动态，还要判断两条记录是不是同一个人。Ploid 建了一个覆盖二十多亿人的索引，开发者可以通过接口、命令行工具和模型上下文协议去搜索、补全、解析身份并取回最新信息。它值得关注是因为它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，主打的是实时检索和实体消解，而不是静态名录。

companies.name: Tesora
companies.originalOneLiner: Frontier AI for Actuaries
companies.originalDescription: Tesora builds frontier AI agents for actuaries at P&C carriers, reinsurers, and MGAs. The agents handle the assembly, pulling the data, running the method, and deploying the rater, while you review the work and make every call. We deploy inside the stack you already run, on your infra and under your IT team's control, with no shared servers and nothing to rip out. Your data never trains our models, or anyone else's. We treat this as a partnership so we stay hands-on until the work is live and holding up in production. That standard runs through our security posture too: SOC 2 Type II certified, with a full audit trail behind every change. The part of the job that matters is actuarial judgment, and we automate everything around it so you get back to the work only you can do. Built by AI technologists and actuaries who want to see this exist and backed by Y Combinator & other top investors.
companies.story: 这是做精算智能体的公司，服务财产险、再保险和承保代理机构。如果你是一名精算师，每天要把数据从各处凑齐、跑完方法、再部署费率表，中间大量时间花在搬运和核对上。Tesora 的智能体替你做这些装配工作，你只负责审阅结果和做判断，而且它部署在你已有的技术栈和基础设施里，数据不拿去训练模型。它值得关注是因为它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队五人，正在招聘，并且通过了 SOC 2 二类认证。

companies.name: Unsiloed AI
companies.originalOneLiner: API for parsing multimodal unstructured data
companies.originalDescription: AI teams spend 6+ months building document workflows, yet fewer than 10% ever reach production. Generic LLM parsers and OCR collapse on multimodal documents with text, tables, images, and charts. Poor parsing and suboptimal chunking cripple RAG pipelines and downstream automation. Unsiloed AI has built state-of-the-art vision models which serves as the infrastructure layer for turning unstructured data into structured, queryable, and LLM-ready assets. Our APIs are already parsing hundreds of thousands of documents for startups and NASDAQ-listed enterprises, powering vertical AI solutions across industries. On public benchmarks, Unsiloed AI consistently outperforms solutions from LlamaIndex, Gemini, Mistral, and Unstructured.io among others.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是解析多模态非结构化数据的接口。假如你是一家人工智能团队的工程负责人，正带着几个人做文档处理流程，结果半年过去还卡在表格、图片和图表混排的解析上，检索增强生成的效果一直起不来。Unsiloed AI 用视觉语言模型把这类文档转成结构化、可查询、适合大模型使用的数据，接口已经在为初创公司和纳斯达克上市企业解析数十万份文档。它值得关注是因为它来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，公开基准上表现优于多个同类方案。

companies.name: Locata
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Referral Automation for Primary Care Clinics
companies.originalDescription: Locata is an AI referral management platform for Primary Care. We deploy AI agents to automate every step of the referral process that back-office staff face daily, from submitting prior authorizations to broadcasting updates and following up with patients. This frees up staff to focus on patient care. Primary care back-offices are severely understaffed and overburdened by administrative work associated with referrals. Additionally, patients suffer navigating the complex referral process, which can have disastrous health effects if they don’t get the care they need. These factors point to a glaring gap in the system—where out of over 100 million specialist referrals issued annually in the US, only half are actually completed. Locata is tackling this problem head-on, saving administrative staff hours each week and ensuring that the referral process goes as smoothly as possible for patients and their providers. Alejandro and Josh met at Stanford where they graduated with BS degrees in Computer Science. Alejandro was a senior software engineer at Meta’s Reality Labs where he led development of several AI features for wearable products and prior to that conducted AI research at Stanford Medicine. Josh graduated with a masters in Computer Science, specializing in AI, before working as a software engineer at Google where he developed AI products that served over 1 billion users. Within two weeks of building our product, we signed a major regional health center and have saved them over 100 hours of work in our first month live.
companies.story: 这是做基层医疗转诊自动化的公司。一个诊所后台工作人员每天要面对大量转诊：提交预授权、通知患者、追着专科那边要结果，人手严重不够。Locata 用智能体把这些步骤接过去，让工作人员腾出手来做患者照护。它值得关注是因为它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，而且它盯的是一个很大的缺口：美国每年发出一亿多次专科转诊，真正完成的只有一半左右。

companies.name: Molagri
companies.originalOneLiner: Resistance free pesticides.
companies.originalDescription: Molagri develops safer, more effective pesticides for agriculture. We design biopesticides that hit a precise molecular target unique to pest insects, knocking out pests while sparing pollinators, beneficial insects, and the wider ecosystem. By modeling how pests are likely to evolve, we stay a step ahead of resistance, keeping our products effective against the pests of today and tomorrow. The higher efficacy and biobased production will also contribute to emissions reductions in both manufacturing and field use. Our founders are PhD lab mates from the University of Toronto who have worked together for six years and published in Nature Communications and Nature Microbiology.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是抗性更低的农药，属于合成生物学和农业生物技术方向。如果你是一名种植户，最头疼的往往是害虫越打越不怕药，而广谱农药又伤到授粉昆虫和益虫。Molagri 设计的生物农药打的是害虫身上独有的分子靶点，只杀害虫，放过蜜蜂和天敌，同时通过建模害虫可能的进化路径来延缓抗性。它值得关注是因为它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，创始人是多伦多大学的博士同学，合作六年，在《自然通讯》和《自然微生物学》上发表过论文。

companies.name: HABU
companies.originalOneLiner: Like Crosby, but for real estate development
companies.originalDescription: HABU is an AI-native real estate development firm that helps real estate investors deploy capital to build housing faster, at lower cost, and with higher yield. We're building an internal AI-native operating system that completes 90%+ of development tasks at 95% faster processing speeds while delivering the same outcomes customers expect externally: high yield, low risk projects. We're selling the outcome, not the inputs to the outcome. Developers are service providers for white-collar investors: they find land, construct buildings, and operate and sell them for a profit. Our customers don't care how the projects are sourced or managed, only that they are completed on time and produce the forecasted returns. We use agentic workflows, geospatial analysis and mapping, and development-specific workflow automation to manage the end-to-end process. The result is 5x more projects per FTE compared to a non-AI developer, 20% faster project schedules, and 10-15% lower total project costs. We're *not* long term property owners, strictly the service provider (fee/merchant developer). $160B was deployed into multifamily in 2025 and $534B into commercial real estate overall. Developers naturally have high operating margins and we are building to be the most operationally and capital efficient developer in the country. Starting first with multifamily in Phoenix and then expanding nationally.
companies.story: 这是做房地产开发的公司，用人工智能驱动整个开发流程。想象你是一位手里有资金、想投住宅项目的投资人，你其实不关心开发商怎么找地、怎么管工地，只关心项目能不能按时交付并拿到预期回报。HABU 把找地、地理空间分析、流程自动化这些环节放进一套内部操作系统，号称能完成九成以上的开发任务，处理速度快很多，人均能同时推进的项目数也更多。它值得关注是因为它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，卖的是结果而不是工具本身。

companies.name: Plena Health
companies.originalOneLiner: Plena is the AI operating system for specialty medical practices
companies.originalDescription: Plena is the AI operating system for specialty medical practices. We automate the administrative workflows that keep clinics running — referrals, fax intake, scheduling, procedure compliance, and collections — end to end, across all the systems a practice already uses. Unlike point solutions that cover a slice of the problem, Plena becomes the operating layer across the entire practice, connecting the systems, teams, and workflows that keep it running. In 10 months we've grown 17x and crossed seven figures in committed ARR across six specialties and eight states, with 80% of growth through word of mouth.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是专科诊所的人工智能操作系统。如果你是一家专科诊所的运营负责人，每天要处理转诊、传真收件、排班、流程合规和收款，系统之间还互不相通。Plena 把这些行政流程端到端接过去，横跨诊所已经在用的各种系统，而不是只解决其中一小块。它值得关注是因为它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，正在招聘，十个月里增长了十七倍，承诺年经常性收入过了七位数，覆盖六个专科和八个州，其中八成增长来自口碑。

companies.name: 9 Mothers
companies.originalOneLiner: Counter Drone Systems. $1.6m sales. We delivered for the DoW.
companies.originalDescription: We have sold $1.6m of systems to the DoW. Multiple systems delivered to the DoW. Our first product - EDDA - is a counter drone system - small, low power, low cost fully autonomous-capable. It's designed to be used on vehicles, bases, or carried - to stop group 1 suicide drones. We have multiple contracts, sales, etc. We have 3 more products with demand in various stages of development. More details at https://9mothers.com
companies.story: 这是做反无人机系统的公司，属于硬科技和防务方向。如果你是一名负责基地或车队防护的安保主管，最担心的是成群的小型自杀式无人机贴地飞来，而传统手段又贵又笨重。9 Mothers 的第一款产品 EDDA 体积小、功耗低、成本低，可以装在车上、架在基地，也可以随身携带，用来拦下这类小型无人机。它值得关注是因为它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队十九人，正在招聘，已经向国防部门交付了多套系统，销售额达到一百六十万美元，另外还有三款产品在开发中。

companies.name: Flai
companies.originalOneLiner: We Bring Customers to Your Dealership
companies.originalDescription: The problem we solve: 56% of dealership leads arrive after business hours, and most dealers lose these potential customers to competitors who happen to be available 24/7. Missing after-hours calls alone costs the average dealership $1M annually in lost revenue. We built Flai to fix this - AI assistants that answer dealership calls 24/7, scheduling test drives, oil changes, or running outbound recall campaigns so no opportunity slips away. The result: No more missed opportunities, no more losing customers to competitors. Our founding team has built voice AI products at HappyRobot, scaled infrastructure at Uber for millions of users, and applied data science at Netflix to solve operational challenges. We're not just answering phones, we're helping dealerships win in an AI-first world where availability determine who gets the sale.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是帮汽车经销商接住客户来电。假如你是一家经销商的销售主管，晚上下班后大量咨询电话打进来没人接，第二天这些人已经在别家订了车。Flai 用智能助手全天候接听电话，安排试驾、预约换油，还能主动打出去做召回活动。它值得关注是因为它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队三十五人，正在招聘，创始团队做过语音人工智能产品、在优步负责过大规模基础设施、在奈飞做过数据科学，而错过下班后来电每年让一家普通经销商损失约一百万美元收入。

readings.title: It Takes 12 Years to IPO. Then Another 2-3 for Your VCs to Get Liquid. And Founders Can Generally Only Sell About ~4% a Year.
readings.story: 很多创始人第一次融资时，脑子里想的都是怎么把公司做大，很少有人一开始就去算自己哪天能把手里那点股份换成现金。等到公司真的走到上市那一步，才发现从起步到敲钟可能已经过去十几年，而上市之后，投资人还需要再等两三年才能把资金收回来。至于创始人自己，通常一年也只能卖掉很小一部分股份。这篇值得读，是因为它把这套时间账摊开来讲，让人看清创业回报的节奏到底有多慢。读的时候可以留意作者是怎么拆解每个阶段的等待成本，以及这种节奏会怎样影响创始人和投资人的耐心。

readings.title: Show HN: CircleIt – Circle something on a web page, your coding agent fixes it
readings.story: 做前端或者写代码的人大概都遇到过这种时刻：页面上某个按钮位置不对，或者某段文字显示得别扭，你想让帮忙写代码的助手去改，却很难用文字说清楚到底是哪一块。于是有人做了个小工具，你直接在网上把出问题的地方圈出来，写代码的助手就知道该动哪里了。这条在技术社区被讨论，值得看的地方在于它回应的是一个人人都碰过、却一直被将就的小麻烦。读的时候可以留意作者是怎么把圈选这个动作和代码修改连起来的，以及这种交互方式会不会改变人和助手配合的习惯。

readings.title: Surveillance company Flock cuts staff as privacy backlash grows
readings.story: 摄像头越来越多地出现在街道、商场和小区门口，很多人一开始并不在意，直到某天发现自己的生活被记录、被分析，才开始追问这些画面去了哪里、谁能看。围绕监控的争论就是这样慢慢升温的，而做这类业务的公司往往在舆论和监管之间左右为难。这篇讲的是其中一家公司因为隐私方面的反弹而裁员，值得读的地方在于它把商业压力和公众情绪放在一起看。读的时候可以留意作者如何呈现反弹从哪来、公司又做了哪些取舍，以及这种张力对同类公司意味着什么。

companies.name: Shepherd Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Robots for high skilled labor powering AI infrastructure
companies.originalDescription: Shepherd Robotics builds general purpose robots for skilled physical work across AI infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Our robots are powered by robot foundation models and use modular, flexible hardware designed to adapt to different environments and tasks. We train our systems on a combination of real world and simulation data so they can learn complex manipulation skills and generalize across workflows. We also provide integration into customers’ existing workflows, starting with data center construction and operations, electrical manufacturing and testing, and electronics manufacturing, where traditional automation struggles with variability, dexterity, and changing environments.
companies.story: 这是做机器人的公司，方向是让机器人承担人工智能基础设施和先进制造里的高技能体力活。假如你是一个数据中心的施工负责人，今天要为一批新服务器上电，却发现熟练电工排期排到了几周后，布线、装配和测试都卡在人工上。Shepherd Robotics 想用通用机器人接住这类工作，它靠机器人基础模型驱动，硬件做成模块化、可灵活调整的形态，训练数据同时来自真实世界和仿真，让机器人学会复杂操作并适应不同流程。它先从数据中心建设与运维、电气制造与测试、电子制造切入，因为这些场景变化多、对手部灵巧度要求高，传统自动化很难应付。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，团队四人，正在把机器人能力放进真实的物理工作现场，而不只是一个软件工具，这一点值得关注。

companies.name: Qlo
companies.originalOneLiner: Legora for commercial insurance carriers
companies.originalDescription: Qlo builds AI agents to run commercial insurance underwriting. We start by fully automating the operational work around risk decisions, become the system of record, and earn autonomy workflow by workflow toward the autonomous AI underwriter. We’re rebuilding underwriting infrastructure from the ground up so human underwriters and AI agents can share the same accounts, rules, documents, permissions, and workflow state. We believe every commercial insurance program will eventually be built and operated end to end by AI agents on Qlo.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是商业保险的核保基础设施。想象你是一名商业保险公司的核保负责人，每天要处理大量账户资料、规则、文档和审批权限，人工核保团队被琐碎的操作工作拖住，真正需要判断风险的时间反而很少。Qlo 用智能体先把风险决策周边的运营工作自动化，再逐步成为记录系统，按工作流一点点获得自主权，目标是走向自主核保。它从底层重建核保基础设施，让人和智能体共享同一套账户、规则、文档、权限和流程状态。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队两人，它押注的是商业保险项目未来会由智能体端到端搭建和运营，这个方向本身就值得看。

companies.name: Mirrors
companies.originalOneLiner: Steer AI agents in real time using lessons from production runs
companies.originalDescription: Production agents handle many different customer workflows. Currently, when one handles a situation badly, an engineer reads the trace and patches the prompt. The next situation needs another exception. Soon, improving the agent becomes a recurring engineering job, and the prompt keeps growing. Mirrors finds patterns in past runs and feedback. Engineers review guidance for a specific situation and preview where it would apply. Mirrors then delivers that guidance while the agent works, inside the team’s existing setup. The team can check whether the change improved the outcome. We’re building Mirrors for engineering teams running customer-facing agents across varied workflows, so they can improve behavior without hardcoding every lesson in the global prompt.
companies.story: 这是给工程团队用的智能体运维工具。如果你负责一个面向客户的智能体产品，今天很可能又收到一条糟糕的对话记录，工程师读完链路日志，往提示词里补一条例外规则，下次再遇到新情况再加一条，提示词越来越长，改进智能体慢慢变成一份长期工程工作。Mirrors 从过去的运行记录和反馈里找规律，让工程师审核针对具体场景的指导，并预览它会用在哪里，然后在智能体工作时把指导送进去，团队还能检查这次改动有没有改善结果。它来自 YC 秋季批次，团队两人，服务的是那些在多种工作流上跑客户智能体的工程团队，让他们不必把每条经验都硬编码进全局提示词。

companies.name: LightSprint
companies.originalOneLiner: Software factory for product teams
companies.originalDescription: Lightsprint is a collaborative software factory for product teams to plan visually, preview live and ship with an army of cloud agents. Your whole team, including non-engineers, can now ship end to end reliably. The company is founded by Ben Ong, an AI investor who previously scaled AI products at SEA Group (NYSE: SE) and Temasek ($300B fund), Benedict Chan who was VP Engineering at Chainlink and CTO at BitGo (NYSE:BTGO), and Heng Hong Lee who built Facebook Messenger in 2013 and was Director of Engineering at Fazz (YC S17).
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向产品团队的协作式软件工厂。假如你是一个产品团队的工程负责人，团队里有人写代码、有人不写代码，大家想一起把想法变成能上线的产品，却总在规划、预览和交付之间来回切换工具。LightSprint 让整个团队可以可视化地规划、实时预览，并借助一批云端智能体完成交付，连非工程角色也能参与端到端上线。它来自 YC 春季批次，团队三人，正在招聘。创始团队包括曾在 SEA Group 和淡马锡负责人工智能产品的 Ben Ong、曾任 Chainlink 工程副总裁和 BitGo 首席技术官的 Benedict Chan，以及 2013 年参与构建 Facebook Messenger、后来担任 Fazz 工程总监的 Heng Hong Lee，这些背景是它值得留意的真实信号。

companies.name: Harbor
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native CRO for clinical trial operations
companies.originalDescription: Harbor is building an AI-native contract research organization (CRO) for clinical trials. We started with an AI-native system of record for clinical trial data (electronic data capture system), grew the software business to seven trials and ~$187k in contracted software revenue over the next twelve months, then expanded into full-service trial execution and signed our first CRO contract worth $1.93M over three years. Clinical trials consume 45% of all new drug and device development spend. While some of that goes to software, sites, and patients, the largest line items are services: project management, monitoring, data management, site coordination, source verification, query resolution, record reconciliation, and analysis. Today, drug and device companies outsource clinical operations to legacy CROs and their massive teams, which is why the CRO market is $82B annually. Harbor delivers the regulated services companies buy from legacy CROs, but built around our AI-native system of record from day one. Our software already automates the core data workflows: study build, data capture, query generation, monitoring, signing, and database lock. Because we own the system of record, we can expand into the surrounding service workflows: site contracting and billing, subject engagement and retention, statistics, reporting, and more. We built Harbor because we lived through the problem.
