companies.originalDescription: Describe an experiment in plain English, and Infera turns it into a validated, instrument-ready run across the equipment your lab already uses. Infera handles the protocol logic, vendor-specific scripts, data, inventory, and institutional knowledge in one system. An AI-native compiler for the lab: one system from intent to execution.
companies.story: 这是给农场做机器人和软件的公司。假如你是一个草莓种植农场的负责人，加州草莓产业规模达三十亿美元，人工成本占到六成，而你在用的软件还是四十年前那一套。Synphony 提供草莓采摘机器人，以及床级分析、数据管道对接和智能体方案，帮农场把种植和采收环节的数据用起来。它值得关注，是因为它来自 YC 春季批次，团队 10 人，先从利润较好、又能积累户外数据壁垒的草莓入手，同时也在向机器人基础模型实验室出售数据和评估服务，甚至收到了半导体和自主太空实验室的机器人需求。

companies.name: Lambda Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Robotics for AI Infrastructure
companies.originalDescription: Lambda Robotics builds and deploys robots for the infrastructure powering frontier AI.
companies.story: 这是为人工智能基础设施做机器人的公司。想象你是一个前沿人工智能数据中心的运维负责人，电力、冷却和机柜密度带来的现场工作越来越重，人手却很难跟上扩张速度。Lambda Robotics 打造并部署用于支撑前沿人工智能的基础设施的机器人，把自动化能力放进真实的机房和设施场景里，而不只是停留在软件层面。它来自 YC 秋季批次，团队 6 人并且正在招聘，切入的是人工智能算力扩张背后越来越受关注的物理基础设施环节，这个方向本身就有观察价值。

readings.title: Show HN: RxFilm Studio–Create and edit your product videos with AI agent
readings.story: 做产品的人大概都经历过这种时刻：功能都做完了，却卡在一条两分钟的介绍视频上，找外包太贵，自己剪又太慢。于是每当有新工具冒出来，技术社区总会先热闹一阵。这条 Show HN 值得看的地方，是它把“用 人工智能 代理来做产品视频”当成一个完整流程来试，而不是只做某个单点特效。读的时候可以留意作者怎么划分创作和编辑这两步，哪些环节交给代理自动完成，哪些仍然留给人来拍板，以及他在演示里优先解决了哪一类最耗时间的活。这样看，比单纯判断它好不好用更有收获。

readings.title: Comma’s hands-off driving tech under investigation after 2 fatal crashes
readings.story: 辅助驾驶这件事，平时用起来像是省心，真出事时却要回答一个很难的问题：车到底替人做了多少决定。每当有致命事故进入调查，行业里做感知、做接管逻辑、做宣传口径的人都会重新紧张起来。这篇报道值得读，是因为它把事故和监管放在一起看，而不是只讲一次撞车。读的时候可以顺着两条线走：一条是调查方到底在追问什么，另一条是厂商此前对外承诺的能力边界在哪里。看作者如何区分技术故障和责任划分，会比记住结论更有用。

readings.title: AT&T Is Automating Away Jobs—and Its Old Telecom Empire
readings.story: 很多老牌公司都走到过这个路口：老业务还在赚钱，但增长已经停了，于是把希望押在自动化和新方向上。外面看是转型，里面的人感受到的却常常是岗位一个个消失。这篇写 AT&T 的文章值得读，是因为它没有停在“人工智能 取代人力”这句口号上，而是去看一家具体公司怎么一边拆掉旧电信业务，一边重新安排剩下的人和工作。读的时候可以注意作者怎么处理时间线：哪些变化是多年积累的结果，哪些是最近才加速的，以及被自动化掉的具体是哪些环节。

companies.name: Moss
companies.originalOneLiner: Real-time semantic search for Conversational AI
companies.originalDescription: Moss is building the real-time semantic search runtime for conversational and multimodal AI. Our system enables voice agents, copilots, and chat interfaces to retrieve, reason, and respond in sub-10 ms, delivering the responsiveness that makes AI interactions feel truly natural. If you’ve ever built a conversational or voice AI product, you’ve felt the lag. That moment when an agent pauses and the illusion of intelligence breaks. The bottleneck is almost always retrieval. Each query hops across networks and databases, adding delay and cost. Moss eliminates that gap by keeping retrieval close to where the agent runs. Moss runs natively across browsers, mobile devices, and servers with an optimized vector index built in Rust and WebAssembly. It enables teams to build AI products that feel instant, contextual, and adaptive. The experiences that sustain engagement and unlock new kinds of interaction. For our customers, this translates into tangible business value: stronger user retention, higher conversion, and entirely new product categories made possible by real-time understanding. Moss is already powering production pilots across voice AI and developer platforms, achieving sub-10 ms retrieval and 70–90% token savings compared to traditional pipelines.
companies.story: 这是做对话式人工智能实时检索基础设施的公司。如果你负责一个语音智能体产品，最怕的就是用户说完一句话后，系统愣住半秒才回应，那种停顿会让智能感瞬间消失。Moss 把检索能力放在智能体运行的地方，而不是每次查询都跨网络和数据库绕一圈，从而让语音智能体、副驾驶和聊天界面能在十毫秒以内完成检索、推理和回复。它原生运行在浏览器、手机和服务器上，内置用 Rust 和 WebAssembly 优化的向量索引，让团队做出来的产品感觉即时、有上下文、能适应变化。这家公司来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队五人，正在招聘，方向是开发者工具与软件服务。

companies.name: OneCLI
companies.originalOneLiner: The open source AI teammates for your company.
companies.originalDescription: OneCLI (YC S26) is an open-source AI teammates platform for teams. Like Grok Bot, but self-hostable, loved by developers. Each employee gets their own sandboxed pro assistant agent, connected to their GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Dropbox, or CRM right from the chat/Slack, while the whole workspace runs under one policy your admins control. Agents never hold real secrets: the credential is injected at the network layer, per request, after the call is authorized. You can't steal what isn't there.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是企业内部人工智能助手平台。想象你是一名工程负责人，团队里每个人都想要一个能连上代码仓库、邮箱、文档和客户系统的助手，但你又担心凭据泄露和权限失控。OneCLI 让每位员工在聊天工具里拥有自己沙箱化的专业助手智能体，可以连接 GitHub、Gmail、Notion、Dropbox 或客户关系管理系统，而整个工作区由管理员统一策略管理。智能体本身不持有真实密钥，凭据在网络层按请求注入，只有授权通过后才会出现，拿不到的东西就偷不走。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，是开源项目，团队规模在输入中显示为零，没有招聘信号，但自助部署和凭据隔离的思路值得关注。

companies.name: Alkera AI
companies.originalOneLiner: Reliable and safe data engineering and data science agents
companies.originalDescription: Alkera is a data engineering/analysis/science agent that works in your IDE or CLI. If you’re tired of agents that produce false, or even dangerous, reports about your data, then Alkera is for you. Our agent is equipped with your data’s history and lineage, your team’s knowledge, and tailored plugins for data apps such as Snowflake and dbt. Simply install and connect your services to begin doing trusted agentic data work. We also offer VPC & on-prem deployment options for when data can't leave your boundary.
companies.story: 这是做数据工程与数据科学智能体的公司。假如你是一名数据工程师，最头疼的莫过于智能体生成一份看起来漂亮、实际却错误甚至危险的报告，让你在业务方面前难以交代。Alkera 在集成开发环境或命令行里工作，它掌握你数据的历史和血缘关系、团队的知识，以及针对 Snowflake、dbt 等数据应用的定制插件，安装并连接服务后就能开始可信的智能体数据工作。对于数据不能离开边界的情况，它还提供虚拟私有云和本地部署选项。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人，方向是人工智能、开发者工具、数据科学与数据工程，目前没有招聘信号。

companies.name: Beyond Reach Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Space solar arrays that grow to the size of a football field in orbit
companies.originalDescription: At Beyond Reach Labs we are building solar panels for Space that grow from the size of a dining table to a football field in orbit. Mitch and Pele met 13 years ago as freshmen at UPenn studying mechanical engineering. Mitch recently got his PhD at Carnegie Mellon working with NASA on kilometer-scale deployable structures, and Pele spent seven years at SpaceX leading Dragon parachute engineering, safely returning astronauts from space. The collective satellites today use around 20MW, roughly the output of a datacenter on earth, but by 2030 there is a demand for over 10GW, a 500x increase, largely driven by orbital datacenters, space stations, and lunar outposts. If you want more power, your only option is to launch larger solar panels, which quickly become fragile or impractically expensive. As a result, power constraints already determine whether missions or industries can exist at all. But at Beyond Reach Labs we have introduced a new class of deployable solar panels giving satellites 10x more usable power without increasing launch mass or volume. This works because our patented deployable design changes geometry in space, allowing for us to reach 10x longer while remaining rigid.
companies.story: 这是做太空太阳能阵列的公司。想象你是一颗轨道数据中心的工程负责人，卫星上什么都设计好了，唯独电力不够，而唯一办法是发射更大的太阳能板，可板子一大就变得脆弱或者贵得离谱。Beyond Reach Labs 做的太阳能板在轨道上能从餐桌大小展开到足球场那么大，把发射时的紧凑和运行时的面积分开解决。两位创始人是十三年前在宾夕法尼亚大学读机械工程时认识的，一位在卡内基梅隆大学与 NASA 研究公里级可展开结构，另一位在 SpaceX 领导龙飞船降落伞工程。今天所有卫星合计约二十兆瓦，到 2030 年需求预计超过十吉瓦，轨道数据中心、空间站和月球前哨是主要推手。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队八人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Proximitty
companies.originalOneLiner: AI operating system for commercial loans
companies.originalDescription: Proximitty is the AI operating system for commercial loans - we build regulator-grade AI agents that ingest and parse documents, spread financials, automate loan operations and track covenants. We help FDIC-insured banks and fintechs underwrite faster and scale their loan books without scaling costs.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是商业贷款运营系统。如果你在一家受联邦存款保险公司保险的银行负责贷款审批，每天面对成堆的借款文件、财务报表和契约条款，人工录入和核对既慢又容易出错，想扩大贷款规模就得同步扩招人手。Proximitty 用符合监管要求的智能体来摄取和解析文件、整理财务数据、自动化贷款运营并跟踪契约，帮助银行和金融科技公司更快完成承销，在不按比例增加成本的情况下扩大贷款组合。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，方向是商业贷款的人工智能操作系统。

companies.name: Forge Automation
companies.originalOneLiner: Software Enabled CNC Parts Supplier
companies.originalDescription: Forge Automation runs software enabled factories that deliver custom metal parts in four days or less. Instead of mechanical engineers having to wait two to three weeks for their low volume CNC parts, they can simply upload a CAD model on our platform and we will ship it out in four days or less. We aim to give mechanical engineers the "Amazon experience" for custom metal parts.
companies.story: 这是做软件驱动数控零件供应的公司。假如你是一名机械工程师，设计改了一版，只需要少量定制金属件，却要等两三个星期才能拿到，项目节奏全被打乱。Forge Automation 经营软件驱动的工厂，你只需在平台上上传计算机辅助设计模型，四天或更短时间就能收到零件，目标是让定制金属件拥有像网购一样的体验。它来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队二十一人，正在招聘，方向涵盖硬科技、硬件、机器人与制造，用软件把工厂产能和交付速度重新组织起来。

companies.name: Scheduling Wizard
companies.originalOneLiner: Logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations
companies.originalDescription: Scheduling Wizard is building the logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations. Hospitals still rely on manual workflows to manage staffing, patient flow, and core operations, contributing to $760B in annual inefficiency. 20 departments across 16 hospitals already outsource their physician scheduling to us, powered by our internal Scheduling Programming Language and AI-driven workflows. We work with Mass General, Johns Hopkins, UT Southwestern, UCSF, and many others. We are actively onboarding new clients and expanding into patient triaging and provider management systems, working with partner departments at UCSF and other leading institutions. Scheduling Wizard aims to bring healthcare operations into the future by reducing administrative burden and improving clinical care coordination. Our goal is to create the AI-native administrative layer in healthcare operations.
companies.story: 这是做医疗运营物流基础设施的公司。如果你是一家医院的运营负责人，每天要为二十个科室排医生班表、安排病人流转，靠手工表格和电话协调，稍有变动就牵一发动全身。Scheduling Wizard 把医生排班外包承接过来，用内部的排班编程语言和人工智能工作流驱动，目前已有十六家医院的二十个科室在使用，合作机构包括麻省总医院、约翰斯·霍普金斯、德克萨斯大学西南医学中心和加州大学旧金山分校。它正在扩展病人分诊和医生管理系统，目标是在医疗运营中建立人工智能原生的行政层。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队三人，目前没有招聘信号。

companies.name: Hlabs
companies.originalOneLiner: US-Made Parts for Robots
companies.originalDescription: HLabs is making an industrial supply chain for building robots in the USA including electronics and actuators, with a focus on in-house manufacturing. Robotics is going to be one of the largest industries the world has ever seen. Teams have to buy what they can from overseas and then build everything else in house just to get something to move. HLabs is producing a plug and play set of robotic primitives to accelerate the early development and then working with larger scale production robots for bespoke designs. Early customers span across household robotics, humanoids, robot arms, quadrupeds, and defense. Hlabs is founded by Paul, a second time YC founder who also participated in the W21 batch with Mystic. He ran Mystic as CEO for 6 years.
companies.story: 这是做美国本土机器人零部件供应的公司。想象你是一支机器人团队的硬件负责人，想让样机先动起来，却发现电子件和执行器大多只能从海外买，剩下的都得自己从头造，进度被供应链拖住。HLabs 在美国建立机器人的工业供应链，包括电子件和执行器，并侧重自有制造，先提供即插即用的机器人基础模块加速早期开发，再为规模化生产的机器人做定制设计，早期客户覆盖家用机器人、人形机器人、机械臂、四足机器人和国防领域。创始人 Paul 是第二次参与 YC 的创业者，此前在 W21 批次创办 Mystic 并担任六年首席执行官。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队一人，目前没有招聘信号。

companies.name: Harper
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native commercial insurance brokerage
companies.originalDescription: At Harper, we are building a fully autonomous commercial insurance brokerage powered by AI. Our initial focus is on mid-sized businesses with complex insurance needs, but our vision is to eventually serve every business in the country. By leveraging AI to automate key workflows in the insurance process, we efficiently secure optimal coverage for each client's unique requirements at competitive prices and with rapid turnaround. Our AI system learns from the expertise of our brokers, accumulating not just knowledge but also the specific workflows, data, and capabilities that pave the way to full autonomy.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是商业保险经纪。假如你是一家中型企业的财务负责人，公司业务复杂，保险需求每年都在变，找经纪人比价、填表、等报价往往要拖上好几周。Harper 用人工智能搭建全自动商业保险经纪，先从保险需求复杂的中型企业入手，自动完成保险流程中的关键工作，为客户争取合适保障、有竞争力的价格和更快的周转。它的人工智能系统从自家经纪人的专业经验中学习，积累的不只是知识，还有具体工作流、数据和能力，逐步走向完全自主。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队二十五人，正在招聘，方向是金融科技、保险与人工智能。

companies.name: Instinct
companies.originalOneLiner: Trade with superhuman instinct
companies.originalDescription: Capital allocation is becoming a more important part of individual economic life. Finance is moving toward a global, onchain, 24/7 future with thousands of markets trading at once. The asset management industry is built around the scarcity of financial expertise and the cost of organizing people around capital. Institutions cover global markets by employing analysts, researchers, and quants around the clock. AI turns this organizational capacity into software. Instinct is building the harness for this transition. Instinct is a proactive team of agents that searches thousands of markets, investigates opportunities, and operates 24/7. The individual becomes the portfolio manager, Instinct becomes the investment firm operating around them. As institutional advantages become widely accessible, the edge concentrates in each trader’s worldview, judgment, and bets. The first one-person investment firm managing $1 billion will emerge within two years. It will run on Instinct.
companies.story: 这是做交易智能体的公司。如果你是一个自己管理资金的交易者，白天上班，晚上还要盯几千个市场，机构和量化团队却能二十四小时轮班覆盖全球市场，这种人力差距很难靠个人弥补。Instinct 做的是一个主动型智能体团队，持续搜索数千个市场、调查机会并全天候运行，让个人成为投资组合经理，而它充当围绕这个人运转的投资机构。随着机构级优势变得普遍可得，真正的优势会集中到每个交易者的世界观、判断和押注上。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，方向是人工智能、机器学习、交易与加密货币，目前没有招聘信号。

readings.title: Show HN: OpenDecision – a 400M zero-shot model makes local decisions, plays Doom
readings.story: 很多人对本地跑模型这件事的印象还停留在“得有好显卡、得联网、得折腾半天”。可当一个只有 4 亿参数的小模型，能在你自己的笔记本上零样本做判断，甚至还能玩《毁灭战士》，这个印象就开始松动了。这条在 Hacker News 上被讨论的展示，值得读的地方不在于它多能打，而在于它把“本地决策”这件事的门槛摆到了台面上：小模型能不能承担一部分原本要交给云端或人工的判断？读的时候可以留意作者怎么定义“决策”这个任务，怎么处理零样本和本地运行之间的取舍，以及他为什么选 Doom 来做演示。看这些选择，比看跑分更能理解这个方向现在卡在哪。

readings.title: Corridor raises $25M seed to build a health benefits brokerage for SMBs
readings.story: 如果你自己开过小店，或者帮几十人的小公司管过员工福利，大概会记得那种感觉：保险方案一年一换，条款看不懂，续保时才发现涨了不少，却没人能说清为什么。美国的健康福利经纪长期服务大公司，小公司往往只能自己摸索。Corridor 拿到 2500 万美元种子轮，说要专门给中小企业做健康福利经纪，这条新闻值得读的地方就在这里：它押的是一个被忽略很久的群体。读的时候可以看它打算怎么把原本靠人跑腿、靠关系报价的活变成可复制的产品，以及融资规模说明投资人相信什么。

readings.title: Pruning LLMs Like a Physicist: Block Removal as an Ising Optimization Problem
readings.story: 训练一个大模型很贵，用起来也不便宜，于是很多人想把它剪小一点：去掉一些层、一些块，让它在保持效果的同时跑得更快。问题是，去掉哪一块才不伤筋动骨，这件事一直靠经验和试错。这篇文章把剪模型里的“块删除”换了一个角度，当成物理里常见的伊辛优化问题来解。它值得读，是因为它展示了一种把工程难题翻译成另一门学科语言的思路。读的时候可以重点看作者怎么把“删哪一块”写成数学形式，怎么判断哪些块可以动，以及这种类比到底省下了什么。
